Emergency.en:
I'm really glad you told me. What is happening is not your fault, and you don't have to face it alone.

Please get help now:
- In danger right now: call 112
- Isange One Stop Centre (free medical, emotional and legal help): 3029, toll-free
- Under 18: child helpline 116, toll-free
- Heavy bleeding, severe pain or feeling very sick: go to the nearest health centre or hospital now

If someone forced you into sex in the last 3 days, go to Isange or a health centre today: medicine can prevent HIV and pregnancy, and it works best quickly.
Emergency.rw:
Nishimiye ko wabimbwiye. Ibikubaho si amakosa yawe, kandi ntugomba kubinyuramo wenyine.

Shaka ubufasha nonaha:
- Niba uri mu kaga ubu: hamagara 112
- Isange One Stop Centre (ubuvuzi, ubujyanama n'ubufasha mu by'amategeko ku buntu): 3029, ni ubuntu
- Niba uri munsi y'imyaka 18: umurongo wo gufasha abana 116, ni ubuntu
- Niba uva amaraso menshi, uribwa cyane cyangwa urembye: jya ku kigo nderabuzima cyangwa ibitaro bikwegereye nonaha

Niba hari uwagufashe ku ngufu mu minsi 3 ishize, jya kuri Isange cyangwa ku kigo nderabuzima uyu munsi: hari imiti irinda virusi itera SIDA no gutwita, kandi ikora neza iyo ifashwe vuba.

qa: A period is when the uterus sheds blood and tissue through the vagina. It is a natural and healthy part of growing up. It usually lasts 2 to 5 days, but this is different for everyone.

Imihango ni igihe nyababyeyi isohora amaraso n'utundi turemangingo binyuze mu gitsina. Ni ibisanzwe kandi ni ikimenyetso cy'uko umubiri ukura neza. Akenshi imara iminsi 2 kugeza kuri 5, ariko biratandukana ku muntu ku wundi.
When will I get my first period?

Most girls get their first period between ages 10 and 16. Every body has its own timing. Things like poor nutrition, a lot of hard exercise or some health problems can delay it. If you are worried about your timing, a health worker can check that everything is okay.
Nzajya mu mihango bwa mbere ryari?

Abakobwa benshi bajya mu mihango bwa mbere hagati y'imyaka 10 na 16. Buri mubiri ugira igihe cyawo. Imirire mibi, imyitozo ikomeye cyane cyangwa ibibazo bimwe by'ubuzima bishobora kubitinza. Niba bigutera impungenge, umukozi w'ubuzima yagusuzuma akareba ko byose bimeze neza.
My period comes at different times every month. Is something wrong with me?

Cycles are often around 28 days, but they can be shorter or longer, and it is common for them to change from month to month in the first years after periods start. See a health worker if your periods stay very irregular, come very rarely, or last much longer than usual.
Imihango yanjye iza mu bihe bitandukanye buri kwezi. Hari ikibazo mfite?

Ukwezi k'imihango akenshi kumara iminsi 28, ariko gushobora kuba kugufi cyangwa kurekure, kandi ni ibisanzwe ko guhinduka mu myaka ya mbere nyuma yo gutangira imihango. Jya kwa muganga niba imihango ikomeje kuza nabi cyane, ikaza gake cyane, cyangwa ikamara igihe kirekire kurusha uko bisanzwe.
My period is so heavy I soak through pads fast and feel dizzy. Is that okay?

Very heavy or long periods are a sign to get checked. They can have causes like a hormone imbalance, and losing a lot of blood can cause anaemia, which makes you feel tired, weak or dizzy. Please visit a health worker soon. If you feel faint or bleeding is very heavy, go today.
Imihango yanjye ni myinshi cyane, nduzura cotex vuba kandi nkumva nzunguye. Ni byo?

Imihango myinshi cyane cyangwa imara igihe kirekire ni ikimenyetso cyo kujya kwisuzumisha. Ishobora guterwa n'imisemburo itaringaniye, kandi gutakaza amaraso menshi bishobora gutera kubura amaraso, bigatuma wumva unaniwe, ufite intege nke cyangwa uzungera. Jya kwa muganga vuba. Niba wumva ugiye guta ubwenge cyangwa amaraso ari menshi cyane, genda uyu munsi.
Is it normal to have strong pain during my period?
Cramps during periods are common. But pain should not stop your life. If the pain makes you miss school or daily activities, a health worker can help find the cause and ways to manage it.
Ni ibisanzwe kubabara cyane mu gihe cy'imihango?

Kuribwa mu nda mu gihe cy'imihango birasanzwe. Ariko ububabare ntibukwiye kukubuza kubaho. Niba bugutera gusiba ishuri cyangwa ibikorwa bya buri munsi, umukozi w'ubuzima yagufasha kumenya icyabuteye n'uburyo bwo kubworoshya.
Can I bathe or wash during my period?

Yes. Washing your body and private parts with clean water and soap during your period is part of good hygiene. Beliefs that washing during a period is harmful are not true, and avoiding washing can increase the risk of infection.
Nshobora koga cyangwa kwisukura ndi mu mihango?

Yego. Koga umubiri n'imyanya ndangagitsina ukoresheje amazi meza n'isabune mu gihe cy'imihango ni isuku nziza. Ibivugwa ko koga uri mu mihango ari bibi si ukuri, kandi kutisukura byongera ibyago byo kwandura indwara.
Can I play sport and go to school when I have my period?
Yes. You can exercise, play sport, swim, bathe, work and go to school during your period. Any limits are cultural, not because your body cannot do it.
Nshobora gukina siporo no kujya ku ishuri ndi mu mihango?
Yego. Ushobora gukora imyitozo, gukina, koga, gukora no kujya ku ishuri uri mu mihango. Imbogamizi zihari ni iz'umuco, si uko umubiri wawe utabishoboye.
Are there foods I should not eat or cook during my period?
No. There are no foods you need to avoid during your period, and you can cook as usual. Eating well actually helps your body.
Hari ibiryo ntagomba kurya cyangwa guteka ndi mu mihango?
Oya. Nta biryo ugomba kwirinda mu gihe cy'imihango, kandi ushobora guteka nk'ibisanzwe. Kurya neza bifasha umubiri wawe.
What can I use during my period? Pads, cloth or something else?

You can use disposable pads, reusable pads, menstrual cups, tampons, period underwear or clean absorbent cloth. Pick what is comfortable and available for you. Change it regularly, change in a clean private place, and wash reusable products with soap and water. If you use tampons, change them often.
Nakoresha iki mu gihe cy'imihango? Cotex, igitambaro cyangwa ikindi?

Ushobora gukoresha cotex zikoreshwa rimwe, cotex zongera gukoreshwa, menstrual cup, tampon, amakariso yabugenewe cyangwa igitambaro gisukuye kinyunyuza. Hitamo icyo wisanzuyeho kandi ubona. Gihindure kenshi, uhindurire ahantu hasukuye kandi hiherereye, kandi umese ibyongera gukoreshwa ukoresheje amazi n'isabune.
Can I get pregnant if I have sex during my period?

Yes, it is possible, especially if your cycles are short or irregular. Also, some bleeding that is not a period can be mistaken for one. The only reliable way to prevent pregnancy is a modern contraceptive method.
Nshobora gutwita ndamutse nkoze imibonano mpuzabitsina ndi mu mihango?

Yego, birashoboka, cyane cyane niba ukwezi kwawe ari kugufi cyangwa guhindagurika. Kandi amaraso amwe atari imihango ashobora kwitiranywa nayo. Uburyo bwizewe bwo kwirinda gutwita ni ugukoresha uburyo bwa kijyambere bwo kuboneza urubyaro.

For girls, puberty can start as early as 8 or as late as 13 or 14. For boys, it can start around 9 or as late as 15. All the changes can take several years. Everybody goes through puberty at their own pace.

Ku bakobwa, ubwangavu bushobora gutangira ku myaka 8 cyangwa bugatinda kugeza ku myaka 13 cyangwa 14. Ku bahungu, ubugimbi bushobora gutangira ku myaka 9 cyangwa bugatinda kugeza ku myaka 15. Impinduka zose zishobora kumara imyaka myinshi. Buri wese akura ku muvuduko we.
What changes happen to girls in puberty?

Girls usually grow taller quickly, develop breasts, and grow hair under the arms and around the genitals. Some get pimples and stronger body smell. Periods begin. The first period means the body can now become pregnant through unprotected sex.
Ni izihe mpinduka ziba ku bakobwa mu bwangavu?

Abakobwa akenshi barakura vuba, amabere akamera, ubwoya bukamera mu maha no ku myanya ndangagitsina. Bamwe bazana ibiheri n'impumuro y'umubiri ikiyongera. Imihango iratangira. Imihango ya mbere bisobanura ko umubiri ushobora gutwita ukoze imibonano idakingiye.
What changes happen to boys in puberty?

Boys grow hair on the face, under the arms and around the genitals. They grow taller, shoulders get wider, the voice gets deeper and the genitals grow. Some get pimples or stronger body smell. Erections happen more often, sometimes at random times. Some boys get slight breast growth that goes away.
Ni izihe mpinduka ziba ku bahungu mu bugimbi?

Abahungu bamera ubwanwa, ubwoya mu maha no ku myanya ndangagitsina. Barakura, ibitugu bikaguka, ijwi rikaba rinini kandi igitsina kigakura. Bamwe bazana ibiheri cyangwa impumuro y'umubiri. Igitsina gihagarara kenshi, rimwe na rimwe nta mpamvu. Bamwe babyimba gato mu gituza bikazashira.
I woke up wet at night. What is a wet dream and is it normal?
A wet dream is when semen comes out during sleep. It is a normal part of puberty. Having wet dreams, or not having them, are both normal.
Nabyutse nsanga natose nijoro. Kurota usohora ni iki kandi ni ibisanzwe?
Kurota usohora ni igihe intanga zisohoka uri mu bitotsi. Ni ibisanzwe mu bugimbi. Kubirota cyangwa kutabirota, byombi ni ibisanzwe.
Why do my moods change so much lately?

Puberty brings changes in feelings too. Mood swings, new romantic or sexual feelings and wanting more privacy are all common. If you feel sad or worried most of the time, talk to someone you trust or a health worker.
Kuki amarangamutima yanjye ahinduka cyane muri iyi minsi?

Ubwangavu n'ubugimbi bizana n'impinduka mu marangamutima. Guhindagurika mu byiyumvo, ibyiyumvo bishya by'urukundo n'ubushake bwo kwiherera ni ibisanzwe. Niba wumva ufite agahinda cyangwa impungenge igihe kinini, vugana n'umuntu wizeye cyangwa umukozi w'ubuzima.
What ways are there to prevent pregnancy?

There are many options. Implants and IUDs work very well and last for years. Pills, injections, patches and rings work well when used correctly and on time. Condoms prevent pregnancy and also protect against STIs. Counting 'safe days' and pulling out are less reliable. A nurse can help you choose what fits you.
Ni ubuhe buryo buhari bwo kwirinda gutwita?

Hari uburyo bwinshi. Agapira ko mu kuboko (implant) na IUD bikora neza cyane kandi bimara imyaka. Ibinini, inshinge n'ubundi buryo bikora neza iyo bikoreshejwe neza kandi ku gihe. Agakingirizo karinda gutwita kandi kakarinda indwara zandurira mu mibonano. Kubara iminsi no gusohorera hanze ntibyizewe. Umuforomo yagufasha guhitamo ikikubereye.
Which family planning method also protects against HIV and STIs?

Condoms are the only method that protects against both pregnancy and STIs, including HIV. Other methods, like pills or implants, prevent pregnancy only. Many people use a condom together with another method.
Ni ubuhe buryo bwo kuboneza urubyaro burinda na SIDA n'indwara zandurira mu mibonano?

Agakingirizo ni bwo buryo bwonyine burinda gutwita n'indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina, harimo na virusi itera SIDA. Ubundi buryo nk'ibinini cyangwa agapira burinda gutwita gusa. Abantu benshi bakoresha agakingirizo hamwe n'ubundi buryo.
Will using family planning stop me from having children later?
No. Modern contraceptive methods do not cause infertility. With most methods, you can get pregnant soon after stopping. With some, like the injection, it can take a few months.
Gukoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro bizambuza kubyara nyuma?
Oya. Uburyo bwa kijyambere bwo kuboneza urubyaro ntibutera ubugumba. Ku buryo bwinshi, ushobora gutwita vuba nyuma yo kubuhagarika. Ku bundi, nk'urushinge, bishobora gufata amezi make.
How well do condoms prevent pregnancy?

When used correctly every single time, about 2 in 100 women get pregnant in a year. With how people usually use them, sometimes skipping or using them wrong, it is about 15 in 100. Using a condom correctly every time makes the difference.
Agakingirizo karinda gutwita ku kigero kingana iki?

Iyo gakoreshejwe neza buri gihe, abagore nka 2 ku 100 ni bo batwita mu mwaka. Uko abantu bagakoresha bisanzwe, rimwe na rimwe bakibagirwa cyangwa bakagakoresha nabi, ni nka 15 ku 100. Kugakoresha neza buri gihe ni byo bituma gakora.
How do I put on a condom correctly?

1. Check the pack is not damaged or expired, and open it with fingers, not teeth. 2. Put it on the tip of the hard penis before any contact, rolled side out. 3. Roll it all the way down. 4. After coming, hold the rim and pull out while still hard. 5. Slide it off without spilling, wrap it and throw it in the bin or latrine. Use a new condom every time.

1. Reba ko agapaki kadacitse kandi kataragera ku itariki yo kurangira, ugafungure n'intoki, si amenyo. 2. Kambike ku mutwe w'igitsina gihagaze mbere yo gukoranaho, uruhande ruzinze ruri hanze. 3. Kazingurure kugeza hasi. 4. Nyuma yo gusohora, fata umunwa wako ukuremo igitsina kigihagaze. 5. Kakuremo utameneka, ugapfunyike ukajugunye mu kimpoteri cyangwa mu musarane. Koresha agashya buri gihe.
Can we use Vaseline or body lotion with a condom?
No. Oil-based products like Vaseline, lotion, cooking oil, baby oil or butter damage condoms and can make them break. Use water-based or silicone-based lubricant, or water.
Dushobora gukoresha vazeline cyangwa amavuta yo kwisiga n'agakingirizo?

Oya. Ibintu birimo amavuta nka vazeline, amavuta yo kwisiga, amavuta yo guteka cyangwa amavuta y'inka byangiza agakingirizo kandi bishobora gutuma gacika. Koresha amavuta yabugenewe ashingiye ku mazi, cyangwa amazi.
Is it safer to wear two condoms at once?
No, using two condoms at once is not recommended. The rubbing between them can make them more likely to break. One condom used correctly is the safest.
Kwambara udukingirizo tubiri icyarimwe ni byo byizewe kurushaho?
Oya, ntibyemewe. Gukubana kwatwo bituma ducika vuba. Agakingirizo kamwe gakoreshejwe neza ni ko kizewe kurusha.
The condom broke during sex. What should I do now?

Act soon. Emergency contraceptive pills can lower the chance of pregnancy and work best the sooner you take them, within 5 days. If there is a chance of HIV, go to a health centre as soon as possible for PEP, ideally within 24 hours and no later than 72 hours. Washing or douching does not help.
Agakingirizo kacitse turi mu mibonano. Nkore iki ubu?

Bikore vuba. Ibinini byo kwirinda gutwita byihutirwa bigabanya ibyago byo gutwita kandi bikora neza iyo bifashwe vuba, mu minsi 5. Niba hari ibyago bya virusi itera SIDA, jya ku kigo nderabuzima vuba ushoboka uhabwe PEP, byiza mu masaha 24 kandi bitarenze amasaha 72. Kwisukura ntibifasha.
Can I wash a condom and use it again?
No. A condom is used only once. Use a new one every time you have sex.
Oya. Agakingirizo gakoreshwa rimwe gusa. Koresha agashya buri gihe ukora imibonano.
We had sex without protection. Is it too late for the emergency pill?

Emergency contraception can be used up to 5 days after sex, but it works best the sooner you use it. A copper IUD put in by a health worker within 5 days is the most effective option. Go to a health centre or pharmacy as soon as you can.
Twakoze imibonano idakingiye. Ese igihe cy'ibinini byihutirwa cyarenze?

Uburyo bwo kwirinda gutwita byihutirwa bushobora gukoreshwa kugeza ku minsi 5 nyuma y'imibonano, ariko bukora neza iyo bukoreshejwe vuba. IUD y'umuringa ishyizwemo n'umukozi w'ubuzima mu minsi 5 ni yo ikora neza kurusha. Jya ku kigo nderabuzima cyangwa kuri farumasi vuba ushoboka.
Is the emergency pill the same as an abortion?
No. Emergency pills work by stopping or delaying the release of an egg. They do not cause abortion, and they cannot end a pregnancy that has already started or harm it.
Ikinini cyihutirwa ni kimwe no gukuramo inda?
Oya. Ibinini byihutirwa bibuza cyangwa bigatinza irekurwa ry'igi. Ntibikuramo inda, kandi ntibishobora guhagarika inda yamaze gufata cyangwa kuyangiza.
Is the emergency pill safe for teenagers?

Yes. There is no age limit, and it is safe for girls and women. Some people feel sick, get light bleeding or feel tired, which usually passes quickly. If you vomit within 2 hours of taking it, talk to a pharmacist or nurse because you may need another dose.
Ikinini cyihutirwa ntigifite ingaruka ku bangavu?

Nta ngaruka mbi gifite, kandi nta myaka ntarengwa. Bamwe bumva iseseme, bakava amaraso make cyangwa bakumva bananiwe, ariko bihita bishira. Niba uruka mu masaha 2 nyuma yo kugifata, vugana n'umufarumasiye cyangwa umuforomo kuko ushobora gukenera ikindi.
Is it bad to use the emergency pill many times?

It has no known serious health risks, but using it often can disturb your periods and cause more side effects. It is also less effective than a regular method. A nurse can help you find a regular method that suits you.
Ni bibi gukoresha ikinini cyihutirwa kenshi?

Nta ngaruka zikomeye zizwi, ariko kugikoresha kenshi bishobora guhungabanya imihango kandi bikongera ingaruka. Kandi ntigikora neza nk'uburyo buhoraho. Umuforomo yagufasha kubona uburyo buhoraho bukubereye.
Will the emergency pill stop me from having babies in future?
No. Emergency contraception does not affect your future fertility.
Oya. Uburyo bwo kwirinda gutwita byihutirwa ntibugira ingaruka ku bushobozi bwawe bwo kubyara nyuma.
Is counting safe days or pulling out enough to prevent pregnancy?

These methods are less reliable than modern methods. Many pregnancies happen with them, especially when cycles are irregular, as they often are for young people. A condom or another modern method protects you much better.
Kubara iminsi cyangwa gusohorera hanze birahagije mu kwirinda gutwita?

Ubu buryo ntibwizewe nk'ubwa kijyambere. Inda nyinshi ziboneka ku bukoresha, cyane cyane iyo ukwezi guhindagurika, nk'uko bikunze kuba ku rubyiruko. Agakingirizo cyangwa ubundi buryo bwa kijyambere bikurinda neza kurushaho.
Where can a young person get family planning without being judged?

Youth-friendly corners at health centres are there for young people and can explain all options privately. Since September 2025, Law N° 026/2025 allows people aged 15 and above to get contraception and other sexual and reproductive health services without parental consent. Pharmacies also sell condoms and emergency pills.
Urubyiruko rwabona he serivisi zo kuboneza urubyaro rutacirwa urubanza?

Serivisi z'urubyiruko ku bigo nderabuzima zashyiriweho urubyiruko kandi zigusobanurira uburyo bwose mu ibanga. Kuva muri Nzeri 2025, Itegeko N° 026/2025 ryemerera abafite imyaka 15 kuzamura guhabwa uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro n'izindi serivisi z'ubuzima bw'imyororokere batabanje gusaba uruhushya rw'ababyeyi. Farumasi nazo zigurisha udukingirizo n'ibinini byihutirwa.
I feel ashamed to buy condoms. People will think I am a sex worker.

Buying condoms means you care about your health and your partner's. Married couples and many other people use them too. You can also ask at a youth-friendly corner, where staff are there to help, not judge.
Ngira isoni zo kugura udukingirizo. Abantu bazibwira ko ndi indaya.

Kugura udukingirizo bisobanura ko witaye ku buzima bwawe n'ubw'umukunzi wawe. Abashakanye n'abandi benshi baradukoresha. Ushobora no kubaza kuri serivisi z'urubyiruko, aho abakozi baba bahari kugufasha, si ukugucira urubanza.
Can I get pregnant the first time I have sex?
Yes. Once a girl has started her periods, she can get pregnant any time she has unprotected sex, including the very first time.
Nshobora gutwita bwa mbere nkoze imibonano?
Yego. Iyo umukobwa yatangiye imihango, ashobora gutwita igihe cyose akoze imibonano idakingiye, harimo n'iya mbere.
How do I know if I am pregnant?
A missed period is often the first sign. Others can include feeling sick, sore breasts and feeling very tired. A pregnancy test at a health centre or pharmacy can tell you for sure.

Kubura imihango akenshi ni cyo kimenyetso cya mbere. Ibindi bishobora kuba iseseme, amabere ababara no kumva unaniwe cyane. Ikizamini cyo gutwita ku kigo nderabuzima cyangwa kuri farumasi kiguha igisubizo nyacyo.
I think I am pregnant and I am so scared. I don't know what to do.

You are not alone, and it is okay to feel scared. A nurse at a youth-friendly corner can confirm if you are pregnant and talk with you privately about your options and next steps. If someone forced you to have sex, there is free help for you right now.
Youth-friendly corner; Help now if forced
Ndakeka ko natwise kandi mfite ubwoba bwinshi. Sinzi icyo nakora.

Nturi wenyine, kandi ni ibisanzwe kugira ubwoba. Umuforomo kuri serivisi z'urubyiruko yakwemeza niba utwite kandi akakuganiriza mu ibanga ku mahitamo yawe n'intambwe zikurikira. Niba hari uwaguhatiye imibonano, hari ubufasha bw'ubuntu bukugenewe ubu.
Is it dangerous to be pregnant as a teenager?

Pregnancy at a young age carries higher health risks, like high blood pressure problems and infections for the mother, and babies born early or small. Going for antenatal care early at a health centre helps keep you and the baby safe.
Gutwita uri ingimbi cyangwa umwangavu ni bibi?

Gutwita ukiri muto bifite ibyago byinshi, nk'umuvuduko w'amaraso ukabije n'indwara ku mubyeyi, n'abana bavuka igihe kitageze cyangwa bafite ibiro bike. Kwipimisha inda hakiri kare ku kigo nderabuzima bigufasha kurinda wowe n'umwana.

In Rwanda, abortion is legal when the pregnant person is a child, or the pregnancy came from rape, forced marriage or incest, or it puts the health of the mother or baby at risk. No court order is needed. Since a 2024 ministerial order, it can be provided at authorised health centres and clinics as well as hospitals, usually before 22 weeks. For a minor, parents usually make the request, but if they disagree with the child, the child's wish prevails. Your information must be kept confidential.
Recognised doctor at a licensed hospital or polyclinic

Mu Rwanda, gukuramo inda biremewe iyo uyitwite ari umwana, iyo inda yaturutse ku gufatwa ku ngufu, ku gushyingirwa ku gahato cyangwa ku busambanyi hagati y'abafitanye isano ya bugufi, cyangwa iyo ishyira mu kaga ubuzima bw'umubyeyi cyangwa bw'umwana. Ntibisaba icyemezo cy'urukiko. Kuva iteka rya Minisitiri ryo muri 2024, bishobora gukorerwa ku bigo nderabuzima n'amavuriro byemewe ndetse no mu bitaro, akenshi mbere y'ibyumweru 22. Ku mwana utaruzuza imyaka y'ubukure, ababyeyi ni bo bakunze gusaba, ariko iyo batumvikanye n'umwana, icyifuzo cy'umwana ni cyo cyubahirizwa. Amakuru yawe agomba kubikwa mu ibanga.
A friend gave me pills to end a pregnancy. Is it safe to take them?

Please do not take pills or herbs from someone who is not a health worker. Unsafe abortion is a serious danger to your health and life. Talk to a doctor or nurse first so you know your options and stay safe.
Inshuti yampaye ibinini byo gukuramo inda. Nabifata nta kibazo?

Ntufate ibinini cyangwa imiti gakondo uhawe n'utari umukozi w'ubuzima. Gukuramo inda mu buryo butizewe ni akaga gakomeye ku buzima bwawe. Banza uvugane na muganga cyangwa umuforomo kugira ngo umenye amahitamo yawe kandi ugume utekanye.
An older man forced me and now I am pregnant.

This is not your fault, and you deserve care and safety. Isange One Stop Centres give free medical, psychological and legal help: call 3029. If you are under 18 you can also call 116. Pregnancy from rape is one of the legal grounds for abortion in Rwanda, and a doctor can explain your options.
Umugabo mukuru yamfashe ku ngufu none ndatwite.

Si amakosa yawe, kandi ukwiye kwitabwaho no kurindwa. Isange One Stop Centre itanga ubuvuzi, ubujyanama n'ubufasha mu by'amategeko ku buntu: hamagara 3029. Niba uri munsi y'imyaka 18 ushobora no guhamagara 116. Inda ituruka ku gufatwa ku ngufu ni imwe mu mpamvu zemewe n'amategeko zo kuyikuramo mu Rwanda, kandi muganga yagusobanurira amahitamo yawe.
I just had a baby. Where can I get support as a young mother?

Health centres offer care for you and your baby after birth, including family planning when you are ready. Connecting with other young parents can also help. Look for the Young parents group in Community.
Nabyaye vuba. Nabona he ubufasha nk'umubyeyi ukiri muto?
Ibigo nderabuzima bitanga serivisi kuri wowe n'umwana nyuma yo kubyara, harimo no kuboneza urubyaro igihe witeguye. Guhura n'abandi babyeyi bakiri bato nabyo bifasha.
What are STIs and how do people get them?
STIs are infections passed mainly through sex, including vaginal, anal and oral sex. Some can also pass from a mother to her baby during pregnancy, birth or breastfeeding, or through unsafe blood.
Indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina ni izihe kandi zandura zite?

Ni indwara zandura cyane cyane binyuze mu mibonano mpuzabitsina, harimo inyuze mu gitsina, mu kibuno n'ikoresheje umunwa. Zimwe zishobora no kwanduza umwana avuye kuri nyina mu gihe atwite, abyara cyangwa yonsa, cyangwa binyuze mu maraso adasuzumwe.
Can I have an STI and not know it?
Yes. Most STIs have no symptoms at all. The only way to know is to get tested.
Nshobora kurwara indwara yandurira mu mibonano ntabizi?
Yego. Indwara nyinshi zandurira mu mibonano nta bimenyetso zigaragaza. Uburyo bwonyine bwo kumenya ni ukwipimisha.
My private parts itch and there is a smelly discharge. Is it an STI?
These can be signs of an infection, which may or may not be an STI. Please visit a health worker to get checked and treated. Avoid sex or use a condom until you have been seen.
Imyanya ndangagitsina yanjye irandya kandi hari ibintu binuka bisohoka. Ni indwara yandurira mu mibonano?

Ibi bishobora kuba ibimenyetso by'indwara, ishobora kuba yandurira mu mibonano cyangwa itayandurira. Jya kwa muganga usuzumwe kandi uvurwe. Irinde imibonano cyangwa ukoreshe agakingirizo kugeza ubonanye na muganga.

Many can. Chlamydia, gonorrhoea, syphilis and trichomoniasis can usually be cured with antibiotics from a health worker. Herpes and HIV cannot be cured, but medicine controls them well. Hepatitis B can be treated to protect the liver.

Nyinshi zirakira. Mburugu, imitezi, chlamydia na trichomonas akenshi zivurwa n'imiti yica mikorobe itanzwe n'umukozi w'ubuzima. Herpes na virusi itera SIDA ntibikira, ariko imiti irabigenzura neza. Hepatite B ivurwa kugira ngo urinde umwijima.
Do condoms protect against all STIs?

Condoms protect very well against most STIs, including HIV, when used correctly every time. They protect less against infections that cause sores on skin the condom does not cover, like herpes or syphilis.
Agakingirizo karinda indwara zose zandurira mu mibonano?
Agakingirizo karinda neza cyane indwara nyinshi, harimo na virusi itera SIDA, iyo gakoreshejwe neza buri gihe. Ntikarinda cyane indwara zitera ibisebe ku ruhu katapfuka, nka herpes cyangwa mburugu.
Yes. Safe vaccines exist for HPV, which can cause cervical cancer, and for hepatitis B. Ask at your health centre or school health programme about getting vaccinated.
Hari inkingo z'indwara zandurira mu mibonano?
Yego. Hari inkingo zizewe za HPV, ishobora gutera kanseri y'inkondo y'umura, na hepatite B. Baza ku kigo nderabuzima cyangwa muri gahunda y'ubuzima ku ishuri.
I was treated for an STI. Does my partner need treatment too?
Yes. Your partner should also be tested and treated. Otherwise the infection can come back to you or spread to others.
Navuwe indwara yandurira mu mibonano. Umukunzi wanjye nawe akeneye kuvurwa?
Yego. Umukunzi wawe nawe agomba kwipimisha no kuvurwa. Bitabaye ibyo, indwara ishobora kukugarukira cyangwa ikandura abandi.
What happens if an STI is not treated?

Untreated STIs can cause serious problems, like infections that lead to infertility in women, some cancers from HPV, and a higher chance of getting HIV. Getting tested and treated early prevents this.
Bigenda bite iyo indwara yandurira mu mibonano itavuwe?

Indwara zitavuwe zishobora gutera ibibazo bikomeye, nk'indwara zitera ubugumba ku bagore, kanseri zimwe ziterwa na HPV, n'ibyago byinshi byo kwandura virusi itera SIDA. Kwipimisha no kuvurwa hakiri kare birabirinda.
Can I just buy antibiotics myself for an STI?
It is better to see a health worker. Some STIs, like gonorrhoea, no longer respond to many antibiotics, so you need the right test and the right treatment.
Nshobora kwigurira imiti yica mikorobe nkivura indwara yandurira mu mibonano?
Ni byiza kujya kwa muganga. Indwara zimwe nk'imitezi ntizicyumva imiti myinshi, bityo ukeneye ikizamini nyacyo n'umuti ukwiye.
HIV passes mainly through sex without a condom. It can also pass from a mother to her baby during pregnancy, birth or breastfeeding, and through unsafe blood. Condoms protect very well against HIV.

Virusi itera SIDA yandura cyane cyane binyuze mu mibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiye. Ishobora no kuva ku mubyeyi ikajya ku mwana mu gihe atwite, abyara cyangwa yonsa, no binyuze mu maraso adasuzumwe. Agakingirizo karinda neza cyane.
Can you tell if someone has HIV by looking at them?
No. Many people with HIV look and feel healthy. A test is the only way to know.
Wamenya ko umuntu afite virusi itera SIDA umurebye?
Oya. Abantu benshi bafite virusi itera SIDA basa kandi bumva bameze neza. Kwipimisha ni bwo buryo bwonyine bwo kumenya.
Is there a cure for HIV?
Not yet. HIV cannot be cured, but daily treatment controls it, and people with HIV can live long, healthy lives.
Hari umuti ukiza virusi itera SIDA?
Ntawo uraboneka. Virusi itera SIDA ntikira, ariko imiti ifatwa buri munsi irayigenzura, kandi abayifite babaho igihe kirekire kandi bameze neza.
Where can I get tested for HIV?
Health centres offer HIV testing, including rapid tests that give results quickly. Your result is private. Youth-friendly corners are a good place to start.
Ibigo nderabuzima bitanga ikizamini cya virusi itera SIDA, harimo n'ikizamini cyihuse gitanga igisubizo vuba. Igisubizo cyawe ni ibanga. Serivisi z'urubyiruko ni ahantu heza ho gutangirira.
I had sex without a condom last night with someone who might have HIV. What do I do?

Go to a health centre today. There is medicine called PEP that can stop HIV after exposure. Start it as soon as possible, ideally within 24 hours and no later than 72 hours. You can also ask about emergency contraception.
Ejo nakoze imibonano idakingiye n'umuntu ushobora kuba afite virusi itera SIDA. Nkore iki?

Jya ku kigo nderabuzima uyu munsi. Hari imiti yitwa PEP ishobora kukurinda kwandura virusi itera SIDA nyuma yo guhura n'ibyago. Yitangire vuba ushoboka, byiza mu masaha 24 kandi bitarenze amasaha 72. Ushobora no kubaza ibijyanye no kwirinda gutwita byihutirwa.

PrEP is medicine for people who do not have HIV, to lower their chance of getting it. It comes as daily pills and also as a ring or injections. It is for people at higher risk. A health worker can tell you if it is right for you.

PrEP ni imiti ifatwa n'abantu badafite virusi itera SIDA kugira ngo bagabanye ibyago byo kuyandura. Iboneka nk'ibinini bya buri munsi ndetse n'inshinge. Igenewe abafite ibyago byinshi. Umukozi w'ubuzima yakubwira niba ikubereye.
My partner has HIV and takes treatment. Can I still get it?

When someone with HIV takes treatment and their viral load becomes undetectable, they do not pass HIV to sexual partners. Regular check-ups confirm this. Talk with a health worker together about staying protected.
Umukunzi wanjye afite virusi itera SIDA kandi afata imiti. Nshobora kuyandura?

Iyo umuntu ufite virusi itera SIDA afata imiti, ingano ya virusi mu maraso ikagera aho itagaragara, ntashobora kuyanduza abo bakorana imibonano. Kwisuzumisha buri gihe birabyemeza. Muganire n'umukozi w'ubuzima uburyo bwo gukomeza kwirinda.
Consent means a free and clear yes to each sexual act. Anyone can change their mind at any time. Silence, pressure, threats, fear or being drunk is not a yes.

Kwemera bisobanura kuvuga yego ku bushake kandi bigaragara kuri buri gikorwa cy'imibonano. Umuntu wese ashobora guhindura ibitekerezo igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Guceceka, guhatirwa, iterabwoba, ubwoba cyangwa gusinda si yego.
My boyfriend says if I love him I will have sex with him.
You never have to prove love with sex. Someone who loves you will respect your choice and wait until you are ready, or accept if you never want to. Pressure is not love.
Umukunzi wanjye avuga ko niba mukunda nzaryamana nawe.
Ntugomba kwerekana urukundo ukoresheje imibonano. Ugukunda azubaha icyemezo cyawe ategereze kugeza witeguye, cyangwa abyemere niba utabishaka na rimwe. Guhatirwa si urukundo.
He says he will leave me if I don't sleep with him.
That is pressure, and it is not okay. Your body is your choice. A healthy partner does not use threats. If you feel unsafe or forced, help is available.
Avuga ko azantana niba ntaryamanye nawe.
Ibyo ni uguhatirwa, kandi si byiza. Umubiri wawe ni amahitamo yawe. Umukunzi mwiza ntakoresha iterabwoba. Niba wumva udatekanye cyangwa uhatirwa, ubufasha burahari.
My friends laugh at me because I have never had sex.
Lots of young people wait, and that is a healthy choice. You decide when you are ready, not your friends. Real friends respect your choices.
Inshuti zanjye zirampa urw'amenyo kuko ntarakora imibonano.
Urubyiruko rwinshi rurategereza, kandi ni icyemezo cyiza. Ni wowe uhitamo igihe witeguye, si inshuti zawe. Inshuti nyazo zubaha amahitamo yawe.
An older man gives me money and gifts and now wants sex.

Gifts or money never mean you owe anyone sex. Relationships with much older men who give money often come with pressure and risks. If you are under 18, sex with an adult is a crime in Rwanda. You can get confidential help: call 116 or 3029.
Umugabo mukuru ampa amafaranga n'impano none arashaka ko turyamana.

Impano cyangwa amafaranga ntibisobanura ko hari uwo ugomba imibonano. Imibanire n'abagabo bakuru batanga amafaranga ikunze kuzana igitutu n'ibyago. Niba uri munsi y'imyaka 18, kuryamana n'umuntu mukuru ni icyaha mu Rwanda. Ushobora kubona ubufasha mu ibanga: hamagara 116 cyangwa 3029.
Is it wrong to ask a girl if she wants to have sex?
Asking is the right thing to do. Asking and then respecting the answer, whether yes or no, is what consent looks like. Never push after a no.
Ni bibi kubaza umukobwa niba ashaka ko dukora imibonano?
Kubaza ni byo bikwiye. Kubaza no kubaha igisubizo, cyaba yego cyangwa oya, ni byo kwemera. Ntukomeze guhatiriza nyuma yo kubwirwa oya.
My boyfriend checks my phone and tells me who I can talk to.
Controlling who you see or talk to is a form of abuse in a relationship. You deserve trust and freedom. Talk to someone you trust, and if you feel unsafe, help is available.
Umukunzi wanjye asaka telefone yanjye kandi akambwira abo nemerewe kuvugisha.
Kugenzura abo ubona cyangwa abo uvugisha ni uburyo bw'ihohoterwa mu rukundo. Ukwiye kwizerwa no kugira ubwisanzure. Vugana n'umuntu wizeye, kandi niba wumva udatekanye, ubufasha burahari.
My boyfriend hits me when we argue. Isn't fighting normal for couples?
Disagreements happen, but hitting is never normal or okay. This is violence. You can get confidential help: Isange One Stop Centre 3029 or the GBV line 3512. If you are in danger now, call 112.
Isange One Stop Centre 3029 (toll-free); child helpline 116; GBV line 3512; emergency 112
Umukunzi wanjye arankubita iyo dutonganye. Ese gutongana si ibisanzwe mu bakundana?

Kutumvikana birabaho, ariko gukubita si ibisanzwe kandi si byiza na gato. Ni ihohoterwa. Ushobora kubona ubufasha mu ibanga: Isange One Stop Centre 3029 cyangwa umurongo wo kurwanya ihohoterwa 3512. Niba uri mu kaga ubu, hamagara 112.
How can I talk to my parents about sex and relationships?

Many young people find this hard, and many parents do too. Try a calm, private moment, start with a general question, or talk first to another trusted adult like an aunt. You can also use Intyoza to get your facts first.
Naganiriza nte ababyeyi banjye ku mibonano n'urukundo?

Biragora urubyiruko rwinshi, ndetse n'ababyeyi benshi. Gerageza igihe gituje kandi kiherereye, utangire n'ikibazo rusange, cyangwa ubanze uganirize undi muntu mukuru wizeye nka nyogosenge cyangwa nyokorome. Ushobora no gukoresha Intyoza ubanza kumenya amakuru.
At what age is it legal to have sex in Rwanda?

Rwandan law punishes adults who have sex with children (defilement) with 20 to 25 years in prison, and life imprisonment when the child is under 14. Sex between children aged 14 or older without violence or threats is not punished. The legal age of marriage is 21.
Ni ku yihe myaka kuryamana byemewe n'amategeko mu Rwanda?

Amategeko y'u Rwanda ahana umuntu mukuru usambanya umwana igifungo cy'imyaka 20 kugeza kuri 25, n'igifungo cya burundu iyo umwana ari munsi y'imyaka 14. Imibonano hagati y'abana bafite imyaka 14 kuzamura nta gahato cyangwa iterabwoba ntihanwa. Imyaka yemewe yo gushyingirwa ni 21.
How do I know if my relationship is healthy?
A healthy relationship has respect, trust and honest talk. Both people can say no, make decisions together and spend time with friends and family. Fear, threats or control are warning signs.
Namenya nte ko urukundo rwanjye ari rwiza?

Urukundo rwiza rurangwa no kubahana, kwizerana no kuvugisha ukuri. Mwembi mushobora kuvuga oya, gufatira ibyemezo hamwe no kumarana igihe n'inshuti n'umuryango. Ubwoba, iterabwoba cyangwa kugenzurwa ni ibimenyetso byo kwitondera.
I was raped last night. What should I do?

What happened is not your fault. Go to the nearest Isange One Stop Centre as soon as you can, or call 3029 (toll-free). They give free medical, psychological and legal help. Medicine to prevent HIV works best within 72 hours, and emergency contraception within 5 days. If you are in danger now, call 112.
Nafashwe ku ngufu ejo nijoro. Nkore iki?

Ibyabaye si amakosa yawe. Jya kuri Isange One Stop Centre ikwegereye vuba ushoboka, cyangwa uhamagare 3029 (ni ubuntu). Batanga ubuvuzi, ubujyanama n'ubufasha mu by'amategeko ku buntu. Imiti irinda virusi itera SIDA ikora neza mu masaha 72, naho iyo kwirinda gutwita byihutirwa mu minsi 5. Niba uri mu kaga ubu, hamagara 112.
A relative touches me in ways I don't like and tells me to keep it secret.
This is not okay, and it is not your fault. You do not have to keep this secret. Tell an adult you trust, or call the free child helpline 116. Isange One Stop Centres (3029) can also help you.
Umuvandimwe ankoraho mu buryo ntakunda akambwira ko ari ibanga.
Ibi si byiza, kandi si amakosa yawe. Ntugomba kubigira ibanga. Bibwire umuntu mukuru wizeye, cyangwa uhamagare umurongo wo gufasha abana 116 ku buntu. Isange One Stop Centre (3029) nayo yagufasha.
My parents want me to marry a man and I am only 16.
The legal age of marriage in Rwanda is 21, and no one can force you to marry. You can get confidential help from the child helpline 116, the GBV line 3512 or Isange One Stop Centre 3029.
Ababyeyi banjye barashaka kunshyingira umugabo kandi mfite imyaka 16 gusa.

Imyaka yemewe yo gushyingirwa mu Rwanda ni 21, kandi nta wushobora kuguhatira gushyingirwa. Ushobora kubona ubufasha mu ibanga ku murongo wo gufasha abana 116, umurongo wo kurwanya ihohoterwa 3512 cyangwa Isange One Stop Centre 3029.
How do I report gender-based violence?
You can call the GBV line 3512, Isange One Stop Centre 3029, or the child helpline 116 if you are under 18. For an emergency, call 112. You can also contact RIB on 166.
Isange One Stop Centre 3029 (toll-free); child helpline 116; GBV line 3512; emergency 112; RIB 166
Natanga nte ikirego cy'ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina?

Ushobora guhamagara umurongo wo kurwanya ihohoterwa 3512, Isange One Stop Centre 3029, cyangwa umurongo wo gufasha abana 116 niba uri munsi y'imyaka 18. Mu gihe cy'ibyihutirwa, hamagara 112. Ushobora no kwitabaza RIB kuri 166.
If I go to Isange, will they tell the police?
When you report at Isange, the case may be shared with law enforcement. You can ask the staff what will happen before you decide, and they can still give you medical care and support.
Iyo utanze ikirego kuri Isange, dosiye ishobora gushyikirizwa inzego z'umutekano. Ushobora kubaza abakozi ibizakurikiraho mbere yo gufata icyemezo, kandi bashobora gukomeza kuguha ubuvuzi n'ubufasha.
Is it rape if my husband or boyfriend forces me?
Yes. Forcing someone into sex is violence, even by a partner or husband. You deserve safety and help. Call Isange One Stop Centre 3029 or the GBV line 3512.
Ni ugufata ku ngufu niba umugabo wanjye cyangwa umukunzi ampatiye imibonano?

Yego. Guhatira umuntu imibonano ni ihohoterwa, n'iyo byakozwe n'umukunzi cyangwa umugabo. Ukwiye umutekano n'ubufasha. Hamagara Isange One Stop Centre 3029 cyangwa umurongo wo kurwanya ihohoterwa 3512.
My friend told me someone is abusing her. How can I help?

Listen without judging and tell her it is not her fault. Share the help contacts, like Isange 3029 or the GBV line 3512, and offer to go with her. Respect her choices, but if she is in danger now, call 112.
Inshuti yanjye yambwiye ko hari umuntu umuhohotera. Namufasha nte?

Mutege amatwi utamucira urubanza kandi umubwire ko atari amakosa ye. Musangize nimero z'ubufasha, nka Isange 3029 cyangwa umurongo wo kurwanya ihohoterwa 3512, kandi wiyemeze kujyana nawe. Wubahe amahitamo ye, ariko niba ari mu kaga ubu, hamagara 112.
Someone is threatening to share my nude photos if I don't do what they say.

This is not your fault, and you do not have to do what they say. Do not send more photos or money. Save the messages as evidence and report it to RIB on 166 or the GBV line 3512. Tell an adult you trust.
Hari umuntu unkangisha gusakaza amafoto yanjye nambaye ubusa niba ntakoze ibyo ashaka.

Si amakosa yawe, kandi ntugomba gukora ibyo ashaka. Ntukohereze andi mafoto cyangwa amafaranga. Bika ubutumwa nk'ibimenyetso maze ubimenyeshe RIB kuri 166 cyangwa umurongo wo kurwanya ihohoterwa 3512. Bibwire umuntu mukuru wizeye.
Since it happened I can't sleep and I feel scared all the time.
These feelings are a common reaction after violence, and you do not have to face them alone. Counsellors at Isange One Stop Centres and health centres can help you feel safer and cope.
Kuva ibyo byambaho sinsinzira kandi mpora mfite ubwoba.
Ibi byiyumvo bikunze kubaho nyuma y'ihohoterwa, kandi ntugomba kubinyuramo wenyine. Abajyanama kuri Isange One Stop Centre no ku bigo nderabuzima bagufasha kumva utekanye no kubyakira.
I feel sad most of the time and don't enjoy anything anymore.

You are not alone. About 1 in 7 young people has a mental health condition like depression or anxiety, and help works. Talk to someone you trust, a health worker, or call the free RBC health line 114. If you ever think about hurting yourself, get help right away.
Mpora mfite agahinda kandi nta kintu kikinshimisha.

Nturi wenyine. Nka 1 ku rubyiruko 7 afite ikibazo cy'ubuzima bwo mu mutwe nk'agahinda gakabije cyangwa guhangayika, kandi ubufasha burakora. Vugana n'umuntu wizeye, umukozi w'ubuzima, cyangwa uhamagare umurongo wa RBC 114 w'ubuntu. Niba igihe icyo ari cyo cyose utekereza kwigirira nabi, shaka ubufasha ako kanya.
I don't want to live anymore.

I am really glad you told me. You matter, and you do not have to go through this alone. Please call 112 now, or the free RBC health line 114, or go to the nearest health centre or hospital, and tell someone you trust to stay with you.

Nishimiye cyane ko wabimbwiye. Ufite agaciro, kandi ntugomba kubinyuramo wenyine. Hamagara 112 nonaha, cyangwa umurongo wa RBC 114 w'ubuntu, cyangwa ujye ku kigo nderabuzima cyangwa ibitaro bikwegereye, kandi ubwire umuntu wizeye agume iruhande rwawe.
I feel stressed about school and relationships. What can I do?
Regular sleep, exercise and talking with people you trust help a lot. Breaking problems into small steps can make them easier. If stress stops you from daily life, a health worker can help.
Mfite umunaniro ukabije w'amashuri n'urukundo. Nakora iki?
Gusinzira bihagije, gukora imyitozo no kuganira n'abantu wizeye bifasha cyane. Gucamo ibibazo intambwe nto bituma byoroha. Niba umunaniro ukubuza kubaho neza, umukozi w'ubuzima yagufasha.
I hurt myself when I feel bad.
Thank you for telling me. You deserve care and support. Please talk to a health worker or someone you trust soon. If you are hurt or in danger right now, call 112 or go to the nearest health centre.

Urakoze kubimbwira. Ukwiye kwitabwaho no gufashwa. Vugana n'umukozi w'ubuzima cyangwa umuntu wizeye vuba. Niba wakomeretse cyangwa uri mu kaga ubu, hamagara 112 cyangwa ujye ku kigo nderabuzima kikwegereye.
I drink a lot to forget my problems.
Using alcohol to cope can make problems worse and is a risk to your health. Talking to someone you trust or a health worker can help you find better ways to cope.
Nywa inzoga nyinshi kugira ngo nibagirwe ibibazo byanjye.
Gukoresha inzoga mu guhangana n'ibibazo bishobora kubyongera kandi ni ibyago ku buzima bwawe. Kuganira n'umuntu wizeye cyangwa umukozi w'ubuzima byagufasha kubona uburyo bwiza bwo guhangana nabyo.
I am a young mother and I feel overwhelmed.
Being a young parent is hard, and feeling overwhelmed is common. You deserve support. Talk to a health worker at your clinic visits, and connect with other young parents in Community.
Ndi umubyeyi ukiri muto kandi numva ibintu birandenze.
Kuba umubyeyi ukiri muto biragoye, kandi kumva ibintu bikurenze birasanzwe. Ukwiye gufashwa. Vugana n'umukozi w'ubuzima igihe ugiye kwa muganga, kandi uhure n'abandi babyeyi bakiri bato.
Kids at school make fun of my body.
Being bullied is not your fault, and it can really hurt. Tell a teacher, parent or adult you trust. Every body changes at its own pace in puberty.
Abana ku ishuri banseka kubera umubiri wanjye.
Gutotezwa si amakosa yawe, kandi birababaza cyane. Bibwire mwarimu, umubyeyi cyangwa umuntu mukuru wizeye. Buri mubiri uhinduka ku muvuduko wawo mu bwangavu n'ubugimbi.
Myth. Pimples are common in puberty because of hormones. Sex does not cure them. A health worker can help if acne is severe.
Si byo. Ibiheri bikunze kuza mu bwangavu n'ubugimbi kubera imisemburo. Imibonano ntibikiza. Umukozi w'ubuzima yagufasha niba ari byinshi cyane.
Does sex make breasts or buttocks grow bigger?
Myth. Breasts and body shape change because of puberty hormones and genes, not sex.
Imibonano ituma amabere cyangwa ikibuno bikura?
Si byo. Amabere n'imiterere y'umubiri bihinduka kubera imisemburo y'ubwangavu n'uruhererekane, si imibonano.
Does having sex stop period pain?
Myth. Sex is not a treatment for period pain. If pain stops you from daily activities, see a health worker.
Gukora imibonano bihagarika kuribwa mu mihango?
Si byo. Imibonano si umuti wo kuribwa mu mihango. Niba ububabare bukubuza ibikorwa bya buri munsi, jya kwa muganga.
Does a girl grow faster after her first time having sex?
Myth. Growth happens because of puberty and has its own timing. Sex does not change it.
Umukobwa akura vuba nyuma yo gukora imibonano bwa mbere?
Si byo. Gukura biterwa n'ubwangavu kandi bifite igihe cyabyo. Imibonano ntibihindura.
You can't get pregnant the first time.
Myth. Pregnancy can happen any time there is unprotected sex, including the first time.
Ntushobora gutwita ku nshuro ya mbere.
Si byo. Gutwita bishobora kubaho igihe cyose habayeho imibonano idakingiye, harimo n'iya mbere.
Family planning makes you unable to have children.
Myth. Modern methods do not cause infertility.
Si byo. Uburyo bwa kijyambere ntibutera ubugumba.
Condoms have tiny holes that HIV passes through.
Myth. Condoms do not have holes that HIV can pass through, and they are not laced with HIV.
Udukingirizo dufite utwobo duto virusi itera SIDA inyuramo.
Si byo. Udukingirizo ntidufite utwobo virusi itera SIDA ishobora kunyuramo, kandi ntiturimo virusi itera SIDA.
Condoms make men weak or unable to have children.
Myth. Condoms do not make men sterile, weak or impotent, and they do not lower sex drive.
Udukingirizo dutuma abagabo bacika intege cyangwa ntibabyare.
Si byo. Udukingirizo ntidutera abagabo ubugumba, intege nke cyangwa kudahagarika, kandi ntitugabanya ubushake bw'imibonano.
A condom can get lost inside a woman's body.
Myth. A condom cannot get lost in a woman's body. If it slips off inside, it can be removed, and emergency contraception can help prevent pregnancy.
Agakingirizo gashobora kubura mu mubiri w'umugore.
Si byo. Agakingirizo ntigashobora kubura mu mubiri w'umugore. Niba kavuyemo imbere, gashobora gukurwamo, kandi uburyo bwo kwirinda gutwita byihutirwa bushobora gufasha.
Condoms are only for sex workers or people who cheat.
Myth. Married couples and many other people use condoms. Using one shows you care about your health.
Udukingirizo ni utw'indaya cyangwa abaca inyuma abo bashakanye.
Si byo. Abashakanye n'abandi benshi bakoresha udukingirizo. Kugakoresha bigaragaza ko witaye ku buzima bwawe.
Condoms take away all the pleasure.
Partly true for some people. Some men feel less sensation, but a drop or two of water-based lubricant inside the condom can help. Talking with your partner also helps.

Ni ukuri ku bantu bamwe. Abagabo bamwe bumva uburyohe bugabanutse, ariko igitonyanga kimwe cyangwa bibiri by'amavuta ashingiye ku mazi imbere mu gakingirizo bifasha. Kuganira n'umukunzi wawe nabyo bifasha.
Myth. HIV cannot be cured, but treatment controls it so people can live long, healthy lives.
Si byo. Virusi itera SIDA ntikira, ariko imiti irayigenzura bigatuma abantu babaho igihe kirekire kandi bameze neza.
Washing after sex prevents pregnancy and STIs.
Myth. Washing or douching does not prevent pregnancy or STIs, and douching can increase the risk of infection.
Kwisukura nyuma y'imibonano birinda gutwita n'indwara.
Si byo. Kwisukura cyangwa koza imbere ntibirinda gutwita cyangwa indwara zandurira mu mibonano, kandi koza imbere byongera ibyago byo kwandura.
Bathing during your period makes you infertile.
Myth. Washing during your period is healthy and does not cause infertility.
Koga uri mu mihango bitera ubugumba.
Si byo. Kwisukura uri mu mihango ni byiza kandi ntibitera ubugumba.
With abortion you either die or go to jail.

Not true as stated. Unsafe abortion done by untrained people is very dangerous. In Rwanda, abortion done by a recognised doctor is legal for some reasons, such as when the pregnant person is a child or after rape.
Recognised doctor at a licensed hospital

Si ko bimeze. Gukuramo inda bikozwe n'abatabizobereyemo ni akaga gakomeye. Mu Rwanda, gukuramo inda bikozwe na muganga wemewe biremewe ku mpamvu zimwe, nk'iyo uyitwite ari umwana cyangwa nyuma yo gufatwa ku ngufu.
How do I keep track of my period?

Mark the first day of each period on a calendar or in a phone app. Count the days from the first day of one period to the first day of the next: that is your cycle. After a few months you will see your pattern, which helps you get ready and notice changes.

Shyira akamenyetso ku munsi wa mbere w'imihango kuri kalendari cyangwa muri telefone. Bara iminsi kuva ku munsi wa mbere w'imihango kugeza ku wa mbere w'ikurikira: ubwo ni ukwezi kwawe k'imihango. Nyuma y'amezi make uzabona uko bigenda, bigufashe kwitegura no kubona impinduka.
Is it normal to have white discharge from my vagina?

Yes. A clear or white discharge without a strong smell is normal and keeps the vagina clean and healthy. It can change during your cycle. See a health worker if it becomes yellow, green or grey, smells bad, itches or burns.
Ni ibisanzwe kugira amatembabuzi yera ava mu gitsina?

Yego. Amatembabuzi y'umweru cyangwa asa n'amazi atanuka ni ibisanzwe kandi asukura igitsina akakigira kizima. Ashobora guhinduka mu gihe cy'ukwezi kw'imihango. Jya kwa muganga niba abaye umuhondo, icyatsi cyangwa ikijuju, akanuka nabi, akaryaryata cyangwa akokera.
My period is late but I have never had sex. Why?

Periods can be late because of stress, illness, big weight changes, hard exercise or a cycle that is still settling after puberty. If you have never had sex, it is not pregnancy. If periods stop for 3 months or more, see a health worker.
Imihango yanjye yatinze kandi sindakora imibonano. Kuki?

Imihango ishobora gutinda kubera umunaniro w'ibitekerezo, uburwayi, guhinduka cyane kw'ibiro, imyitozo ikomeye cyangwa ukwezi kukiri gutunganya nyuma y'ubwangavu. Niba utarigeze ukora imibonano, si inda. Niba imihango ihagaze amezi 3 cyangwa arenga, jya kwa muganga.
I worry my penis is too small. Is that normal?

Penises come in many sizes and keep growing until the end of puberty, often into the late teens. Size when soft says little about size when erect, and it does not affect being a good partner or having children. If you have pain or other worries, a health worker can check privately.
Ngira impungenge ko igitsina cyanjye ari gito. Ni ibisanzwe?

Ibitsina by'abagabo bigira ingano zitandukanye kandi bikomeza gukura kugeza ubugimbi burangiye, akenshi mu myaka y'ubwangavu ya nyuma. Ingano yacyo kidahagaze ntisobanura ingano yacyo gihagaze, kandi ntibibuza kuba umukunzi mwiza cyangwa kubyara. Niba ubabara cyangwa ufite izindi mpungenge, umukozi w'ubuzima yagusuzuma mu ibanga.
Does male circumcision protect against HIV?

Medical male circumcision lowers a man's risk of getting HIV from a female partner by about 60%, and makes hygiene easier. It does not give full protection, so condoms are still needed. It is done safely and for free at many public health facilities in Rwanda.

Gusiramurwa kwa kiganga bigabanya ibyago umugabo afite byo kwandura virusi itera SIDA ivuye ku mugore ku kigero cya 60%, kandi bikoroshya isuku. Ntibirinda burundu, bityo agakingirizo karacyakenewe. Bikorwa neza kandi ku buntu mu bigo by'ubuzima bya Leta byinshi mu Rwanda.

Yes. Masturbation is common among both boys and girls and is a normal way to explore your body. It does not cause infertility, weakness, madness or harm to your body. It is a personal choice, and it is also fine not to do it.

Yego. Kwikinisha bikunze kubaho ku bahungu no ku bakobwa kandi ni uburyo busanzwe bwo kumenya umubiri wawe. Ntibitera ubugumba, intege nke, ubusazi cyangwa ikindi kibazo ku mubiri. Ni amahitamo yawe bwite, kandi no kutabikora nta kibazo.
I found a lump in my breast. Should I worry?

Breast lumps in teenagers are usually harmless, often linked to hormones and the menstrual cycle. Still, any new lump should be checked by a health worker, especially if it grows, hurts a lot, or there is discharge from the nipple.
Nabonye ikibyimba mu ibere. Nkwiye kugira impungenge?

Ibibyimba mu mabere ku bangavu akenshi nta kibazo biba bifite, kandi bikunze guterwa n'imisemburo n'ukwezi kw'imihango. Ariko ikibyimba gishya cyose gikwiye gusuzumwa n'umukozi w'ubuzima, cyane cyane niba gikura, kibabaza cyane, cyangwa hari ibintu bisohoka mu muyoboro w'ibere.
My period started at school and I have no pad. What can I do?

Stay calm, it happens to many girls. Ask a teacher, school nurse or a friend you trust for a pad. Until then, you can fold clean toilet paper or a clean cloth into your underwear. Tie a sweater around your waist if you are worried about stains.
Imihango yanjye yaje ndi ku ishuri kandi nta cotex mfite. Nakora iki?

Tuza, bibaho ku bakobwa benshi. Saba mwarimu, umuforomo w'ishuri cyangwa inshuti wizeye cotex. Mu gihe utarayibona, ushobora kuzinga impapuro z'isuku cyangwa igitambaro gisukuye ukabishyira mu ikariso. Ziritse umupira mu rukenyerero niba utinya ko amaraso agaragara.
How does the implant work and how long does it last?

The implant is one or two small soft rods put under the skin of the upper arm by a health worker. It releases a hormone that prevents pregnancy for 3 to 5 years, depending on the type, and works more than 99% of the time. It can be removed any time, and fertility returns quickly. Changes in bleeding are common and not harmful.
Agapira ko mu kuboko gakora gate kandi kamara igihe kingana iki?

Agapira ko mu kuboko ni agati gato koroshye kamwe cyangwa tubiri dushyirwa munsi y'uruhu rw'ukuboko n'umukozi w'ubuzima. Gasohora umusemburo urinda gutwita imyaka 3 kugeza kuri 5, bitewe n'ubwoko bwako, kandi gakora neza ku kigero kirenga 99%. Gashobora gukurwamo igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, kandi ubushobozi bwo gusama bugaruka vuba. Guhinduka kw'imihango birasanzwe kandi nta ngaruka mbi.
How does the family planning injection work?

The injection contains a hormone that prevents pregnancy for 3 months, so you need a new injection every 3 months on time. It works very well when not late. Periods may become irregular or stop, which is not harmful. After stopping, it can take a few months for fertility to return.
Urushinge rwo kuboneza urubyaro rukora rute?

Urushinge rurimo umusemburo urinda gutwita amezi 3, bityo ukeneye guterwa urundi buri mezi 3 ku gihe. Rukora neza cyane iyo udakererewe. Imihango ishobora guhindagurika cyangwa igahagarara, kandi nta ngaruka mbi. Nyuma yo kuruhagarika, bishobora gufata amezi make ngo ubushobozi bwo gusama bugaruke.
How do I take the family planning pill, and what if I forget one?

Take one pill every day at about the same time. If you forget one, take it as soon as you remember, even if that means two pills in one day, then continue as normal. If you miss two or more pills, use condoms for 7 days and ask a nurse or pharmacist; you may need emergency contraception if you had sex.
Youth-friendly corner at health centre; pharmacy
Mfata nte ikinini cyo kuboneza urubyaro, kandi bigenda bite nibagiwe kimwe?

Fata ikinini kimwe buri munsi hafi ku isaha imwe. Niba wibagiwe kimwe, gifate ukimara kwibuka, n'iyo byatuma ufata bibiri ku munsi umwe, hanyuma ukomeze nk'ibisanzwe. Niba wibagiwe bibiri cyangwa birenga, koresha agakingirizo iminsi 7 kandi ubaze umuforomo cyangwa umufarumasiye; ushobora gukenera ikinini cyihutirwa niba wakoze imibonano.
Can a young woman who has never had a baby use an IUD?

Yes. The copper IUD is safe for young women, including those who have never given birth. A health worker places it in the uterus; it prevents pregnancy for up to 10 to 12 years and can be removed any time. Periods may be heavier at first. It does not protect against STIs.
Umukobwa utarabyara ashobora gukoresha agapira ko mu mura (IUD)?

Yego. IUD y'umuringa nta ngaruka mbi igira ku bakobwa bakiri bato, harimo n'abatarabyara. Umukozi w'ubuzima ayishyira muri nyababyeyi; irinda gutwita kugeza ku myaka 10 kugeza kuri 12 kandi ishobora gukurwamo igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Imihango ishobora kuba myinshi mu ntangiriro. Ntirinda indwara zandurira mu mibonano.

A female condom is a soft pouch put inside the vagina before sex. It protects against both pregnancy and STIs, including HIV, and the woman can control it. Use a new one each time and never use it together with a male condom.

Agakingirizo k'abagore ni agafuka koroshye gashyirwa mu gitsina mbere y'imibonano. Karinda gutwita n'indwara zandurira mu mibonano, harimo na virusi itera SIDA, kandi umugore ni we ukagenzura. Koresha agashya buri gihe kandi ntukigere ugakoresha hamwe n'agakingirizo k'abagabo.
Do contraceptives make you fat or change your periods?

Some methods can change bleeding patterns, for example lighter, irregular or no periods with the implant or injection. Some people notice small weight changes with the injection, but most methods do not cause big weight gain. These changes are not dangerous. If a side effect bothers you, a nurse can help you switch methods.
Uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro butera kubyibuha cyangwa guhindura imihango?

Uburyo bumwe bushobora guhindura uko imihango iza, urugero imihango mike, ihindagurika cyangwa itaza ku gapira cyangwa ku rushinge. Bamwe babona impinduka nto mu biro ku rushinge, ariko uburyo bwinshi ntibutera kubyibuha cyane. Izi mpinduka si akaga. Niba ingaruka ikubangamira, umuforomo yagufasha guhindura uburyo.
I am 15. Can I get contraception without my parents?

Yes. Under Rwanda's Law N° 026/2025 regulating healthcare services, in force since September 2025, people aged 15 and above can get sexual and reproductive health services, including contraception, without parental consent. A youth-friendly corner at a health centre is a good place to go, and your information should be kept private.
Mfite imyaka 15. Nshobora kubona uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro ntabanje kubaza ababyeyi?

Yego. Hakurikijwe Itegeko N° 026/2025 rigenga serivisi z'ubuvuzi mu Rwanda, ritangira gukurikizwa kuva muri Nzeri 2025, abantu bafite imyaka 15 kuzamura bashobora guhabwa serivisi z'ubuzima bw'imyororokere, harimo no kuboneza urubyaro, batabanje gusaba uruhushya rw'ababyeyi. Serivisi z'urubyiruko ku kigo nderabuzima ni ahantu heza ho kujya, kandi amakuru yawe agomba kugirwa ibanga.
Do I have to pay for family planning?

Public health centres in Rwanda usually offer family planning methods free or at low cost, and condoms are often free there. Pharmacies sell condoms, pills and emergency pills. Ask at your nearest health centre or youth corner what is available.

Ibigo nderabuzima bya Leta mu Rwanda akenshi bitanga uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro ku buntu cyangwa ku giciro gito, kandi akenshi udukingirizo tuhatangirwa ku buntu. Farumasi zigurisha udukingirizo, ibinini n'ibinini byihutirwa. Baza ku kigo nderabuzima cyangwa kuri serivisi z'urubyiruko bikwegereye ibihari.
My boyfriend refuses to use a condom. What can I do?

You have the right to protect yourself. Tell him calmly that you will only have sex with a condom, because it protects you both. If he still refuses, you can say no to sex. Pressure to have sex without protection is not respect. You can also use a female condom or another method for pregnancy, but only condoms protect against STIs.
Umukunzi wanjye yanga gukoresha agakingirizo. Nakora iki?

Ufite uburenganzira bwo kwirinda. Mubwire utuje ko uzakora imibonano gusa mukoresheje agakingirizo, kuko kabarinda mwembi. Niba akomeje kwanga, ushobora kwanga imibonano. Kuguhatira imibonano idakingiye si ukukubaha. Ushobora kandi gukoresha agakingirizo k'abagore cyangwa ubundi buryo bwo kwirinda gutwita, ariko udukingirizo ni two twonyine turinda indwara.

Only in specific conditions: the baby is under 6 months, you breastfeed day and night with no other foods, and your period has not returned. If any of these changes, you can get pregnant, so start another method. A health worker can advise methods that are safe while breastfeeding.

Ni mu bihe byihariye gusa: umwana ari munsi y'amezi 6, wonsa ku manywa na nijoro nta bindi biryo ahabwa, kandi imihango itaragaruka. Niba kimwe muri ibi gihindutse, ushobora gutwita, bityo tangira ubundi buryo. Umukozi w'ubuzima yakugira inama ku buryo butagira ingaruka mu gihe wonsa.
Where can I buy the emergency pill?

Emergency contraceptive pills are sold at pharmacies and are available at health centres and youth corners. You do not need to explain your private life. Take it as soon as possible after unprotected sex, within 5 days.

Ibinini byo kwirinda gutwita byihutirwa bigurishwa muri farumasi kandi biboneka ku bigo nderabuzima no kuri serivisi z'urubyiruko. Ntugomba gusobanura ubuzima bwawe bwite. Gifate vuba bishoboka nyuma y'imibonano idakingiye, mu minsi 5.
When should I start antenatal care visits?

Start as soon as you know you are pregnant, ideally in the first 3 months, and attend all scheduled visits. Antenatal care checks you and the baby, tests for HIV and syphilis, gives vitamins and vaccines, and helps you plan a safe birth at a health facility.

Tangira ukimara kumenya ko utwite, byiza mu mezi 3 ya mbere, kandi ujye mu bisura byose wahawe. Kwipimisha inda bisuzuma wowe n'umwana, bigapima virusi itera SIDA na mburugu, bigatanga vitamine n'inkingo, kandi bigufasha gutegura kubyarira ku kigo cy'ubuzima mu mutekano.
What are danger signs during pregnancy?

Go to a health facility immediately if you have bleeding from the vagina, severe headache or blurred vision, swelling of the face or hands, fever, strong belly pain, fits, water leaking, or the baby stops moving. These can be serious. Call 112 or go straight to the nearest health centre or hospital.
Go to a health facility now; 112
Ni ibihe bimenyetso by'akaga mu gihe cyo gutwita?

Jya ku kigo cy'ubuzima ako kanya niba uva amaraso mu gitsina, urwaye umutwe cyane cyangwa utabona neza, ubyimba mu maso cyangwa mu ntoki, ufite umuriro, uribwa cyane mu nda, ugagara, amazi akava, cyangwa umwana akareka kunyeganyega. Ibi bishobora kuba bikomeye. Hamagara 112 cyangwa ujye ako kanya ku kigo nderabuzima cyangwa ibitaro bikwegereye.
I am pregnant. Can I continue school?

Yes. In Rwanda, pregnant girls and young mothers can continue their studies and return to school after giving birth. Talk to a teacher or school leader you trust, and go for antenatal care. Your education still matters and your future is still yours.

Yego. Mu Rwanda, abakobwa batwite n'ababyeyi bakiri bato bashobora gukomeza amasomo no gusubira ku ishuri nyuma yo kubyara. Vugana na mwarimu cyangwa umuyobozi w'ishuri wizeye, kandi ujye kwipimisha inda. Amashuri yawe aracyafite agaciro kandi ejo hazaza hawe haracyari ahawe.
I think I am having a miscarriage. What should I do?

Bleeding with cramps in early pregnancy can be a miscarriage, and you need to be checked today. Go to a health centre or hospital now, especially if bleeding is heavy, you have fever or feel faint. A miscarriage is not your fault, and care and support are available.
Ndakeka ko inda yanjye irimo kuvamo. Nakora iki?

Kuva amaraso no kuribwa mu nda mu ntangiriro yo gutwita bishobora kuba inda ivamo, kandi ukeneye gusuzumwa uyu munsi. Jya ku kigo nderabuzima cyangwa ku bitaro nonaha, cyane cyane niba amaraso ari menshi, ufite umuriro cyangwa wumva ugiye guta ubwenge. Inda kuvamo si amakosa yawe, kandi ubuvuzi n'ubufasha birahari.
How can I tell my parents I am pregnant?

It is normal to feel afraid. Choose a calm moment, or ask a trusted adult like an aunt, teacher or health worker to be with you or to help start the conversation. Parents are often shocked at first but many become supportive. If you fear violence or being thrown out, a health worker or Isange (3029) can help you stay safe.
Nabwira nte ababyeyi banjye ko ntwite?

Ni ibisanzwe kugira ubwoba. Hitamo igihe gituje, cyangwa usabe umuntu mukuru wizeye nka nyogosenge, mwarimu cyangwa umukozi w'ubuzima kukuba hafi cyangwa kugufasha gutangiza ikiganiro. Ababyeyi benshi babanza gutungurwa ariko nyuma bagafasha. Niba utinya guhohoterwa cyangwa kwirukanwa, umukozi w'ubuzima cyangwa Isange (3029) bagufasha kuguma utekanye.
My girlfriend is pregnant. What should I do as the father?

Stay calm and support her. Go with her to the health centre for a pregnancy test and antenatal care, listen to her feelings, and talk about the next steps together. Being a responsible father means supporting her and the child. If she is under 18 and you are an adult, this is a serious legal matter.
Umukunzi wanjye aratwite. Nakora iki nk'umubyeyi w'umwana?

Tuza kandi umushyigikire. Jyana nawe ku kigo nderabuzima gupima inda no kwipimisha inda, wumve ibyiyumvo bye, kandi muganire hamwe ku ntambwe zikurikira. Kuba umubyeyi w'umugabo ufite inshingano ni ugushyigikira we n'umwana. Niba ari munsi y'imyaka 18 kandi wowe uri mukuru, ni ikibazo gikomeye mu mategeko.
Can I get pregnant without full penetration?

Yes, it is possible. Fluid that comes out before ejaculation can contain sperm, and sperm near the opening of the vagina can move inside. The risk is lower than with full sex but not zero. Use a condom or another method, and emergency contraception if you are worried.

Yego, birashoboka. Amazi asohoka mbere yo gusohora ashobora kuba arimo intanga, kandi intanga ziri hafi y'umunwa w'igitsina zishobora kwinjira. Ibyago ni bike kurusha imibonano yuzuye ariko ntibibura. Koresha agakingirizo cyangwa ubundi buryo, n'ikinini cyihutirwa niba ufite impungenge.
Can oral or anal sex cause pregnancy?
Oral and anal sex do not cause pregnancy, unless semen gets near the vagina. But they can pass STIs, including HIV, so condoms are still important.
Imibonano ikoresheje umunwa cyangwa mu kibuno ishobora gutera inda?

Imibonano ikoresheje umunwa cyangwa mu kibuno ntitera inda, keretse intanga zigeze hafi y'igitsina. Ariko ishobora kwanduza indwara zandurira mu mibonano, harimo na virusi itera SIDA, bityo agakingirizo karacyari ngombwa.
What is the HPV vaccine and who gets it in Rwanda?

HPV is a common virus spread through sexual contact that can cause cervical cancer later in life. Rwanda vaccinates school-age girls against HPV, now with a single dose, and in 2026 began rolling out Gardasil 9, which protects against more types. The vaccine works best before sexual activity starts. Ask at school or your health centre.
Urukingo rwa HPV ni iki kandi ruhabwa ba nde mu Rwanda?

HPV ni virusi ikunze kuboneka yandurira mu mibonano, ishobora gutera kanseri y'inkondo y'umura nyuma y'igihe. U Rwanda rukingira abakobwa bari mu kigero cy'amashuri HPV, ubu bahabwa doze imwe, kandi muri 2026 rwatangiye gutanga Gardasil 9 irinda ubwoko bwinshi kurushaho. Urukingo rukora neza iyo ruhawe mbere yo gutangira imibonano. Baza ku ishuri cyangwa ku kigo nderabuzima.
I have painful sores on my private parts. What could it be?

Painful sores or blisters can be caused by infections like herpes or syphilis. Go to a health worker soon to get checked and treated, and avoid sex until then. Many causes can be treated, and herpes can be controlled with medicine.
Mfite ibisebe bibabaza ku myanya ndangagitsina. Bishobora kuba iki?

Ibisebe bibabaza cyangwa udusebe turimo amazi bishobora guterwa n'indwara nka herpes cyangwa mburugu. Jya kwa muganga vuba usuzumwe kandi uvurwe, kandi wirinde imibonano kugeza icyo gihe. Byinshi mu bitera ibi bivurwa, kandi herpes igenzurwa n'imiti.
I have itching and thick white discharge. Is it an STI?

Itching with thick white discharge is often a yeast infection (thrush), which is common and usually not sexually transmitted. It is easily treated, so see a health worker or pharmacist. Avoid douching and tight synthetic underwear. If it keeps coming back or smells bad, get checked for other infections.
Ndumva uburyaryate kandi hari amatembabuzi y'umweru afatanye. Ni indwara yandurira mu mibonano?

Uburyaryate n'amatembabuzi y'umweru afatanye akenshi biterwa n'imiyege (candida), ikunze kubaho kandi akenshi itandurira mu mibonano. Ivurwa byoroshye, bityo jya kwa muganga cyangwa ku mufarumasiye. Irinde koza imbere mu gitsina n'amakariso afunze ya pulasitiki. Niba igaruka kenshi cyangwa inuka nabi, isuzumishe izindi ndwara.
It burns when I pee and I need to pee often. What is it?

This is often a urinary tract infection, which is common in girls and women and needs treatment from a health worker. Drink plenty of water. If you also have discharge, sores or recently had unprotected sex, it could be an STI, so get tested. Go quickly if you have fever or back pain.
Nokera iyo nyaze kandi nkenera kunyara kenshi. Ni iki?

Ibi akenshi ni indwara y'umuyoboro w'inkari, ikunze kuboneka ku bakobwa n'abagore kandi ikeneye kuvurwa n'umukozi w'ubuzima. Nywa amazi menshi. Niba hari n'amatembabuzi, ibisebe cyangwa uherutse gukora imibonano idakingiye, bishobora kuba indwara yandurira mu mibonano, bityo isuzumishe. Genda vuba niba ufite umuriro cyangwa uribwa mu mugongo.
How is hepatitis B spread and can I be vaccinated?

Hepatitis B is a virus that attacks the liver. It spreads through blood, sex without a condom, and from mother to baby at birth. A safe vaccine protects you for life, and babies in Rwanda are vaccinated. Ask at a health centre about testing and vaccination if you were not vaccinated.
Hepatite B yandura ite kandi nshobora gukingirwa?

Hepatite B ni virusi yibasira umwijima. Yandurira mu maraso, mu mibonano idakingiye, no ku mwana avuka akuye kuri nyina. Urukingo rwizewe rukurinda ubuzima bwawe bwose, kandi abana bavukira mu Rwanda barakingirwa. Baza ku kigo nderabuzima ibijyanye no kwipimisha no gukingirwa niba utarakingiwe.
When should women start cervical cancer screening?

Women are generally advised to start cervical cancer screening from age 30, or from 25 if living with HIV, and repeat it as advised by a health worker. Screening finds changes early, when they are easy to treat. It is quick and available at many health facilities in Rwanda.
Abagore bakwiye gutangira kwisuzumisha kanseri y'inkondo y'umura ryari?

Abagore muri rusange bagirwa inama yo gutangira kwisuzumisha kanseri y'inkondo y'umura kuva ku myaka 30, cyangwa kuva ku myaka 25 ku bafite virusi itera SIDA, bakongera nk'uko umukozi w'ubuzima abagira inama. Kwisuzumisha bibona impinduka hakiri kare, igihe zivurwa byoroshye. Birihuta kandi biboneka mu bigo by'ubuzima byinshi mu Rwanda.
Can I test myself for HIV at home?

Yes. HIV self-test kits let you test privately using a mouth swab or a drop of blood, and Rwanda is making them more available in health facilities, schools, universities and youth centres. A positive self-test must be confirmed at a health centre. A negative result may not show infections from the last 3 months.
Nshobora kwipimisha virusi itera SIDA ndi mu rugo?

Yego. Udukoresho two kwipimisha virusi itera SIDA ubwawe tugufasha kwipimisha mu ibanga ukoresheje amacandwe cyangwa igitonyanga cy'amaraso, kandi u Rwanda ruri kutwongera mu bigo by'ubuzima, mu mashuri, muri kaminuza no mu bigo by'urubyiruko. Igisubizo kigaragaza ko wanduye kigomba kwemezwa ku kigo nderabuzima. Igisubizo kigaragaza ko utanduye gishobora kutagaragaza ubwandu bw'amezi 3 ashize.
I tested negative right after risky sex. Am I safe?

Not yet certain. Tests can miss a new HIV infection in the first weeks, called the window period. Test again about 3 months after the risk. If the risky sex was within the last 72 hours, go now for PEP. Use condoms until you are sure.
Nipimishije nsanga ntanduye nkimara gukora imibonano ifite ibyago. Ndi amahoro?

Ntibiremezwa. Ibizamini bishobora kutabona ubwandu bushya bwa virusi itera SIDA mu byumweru bya mbere, icyo gihe kitwa window period. Ongera wipimishe nyuma y'amezi 3 uhuye n'ibyago. Niba imibonano ifite ibyago yabaye mu masaha 72 ashize, jya nonaha gufata PEP. Koresha agakingirizo kugeza ubyemeje.
Can people living with HIV have relationships and children?

Yes. With daily treatment, people living with HIV can have healthy relationships, sex and children. When the virus is undetectable, they do not pass HIV to partners, and with care during pregnancy and breastfeeding, babies are almost always born free of HIV.
Abantu bafite virusi itera SIDA bashobora gukundana no kubyara?

Yego. Bafata imiti buri munsi, abafite virusi itera SIDA bashobora kugira urukundo ruzima, imibonano n'abana. Iyo virusi itakigaragara mu maraso, ntibayanduza abo bakorana imibonano, kandi bitaweho mu gihe cyo gutwita no konsa, abana bavuka hafi buri gihe nta virusi bafite.
Can a pregnant woman with HIV protect her baby?

Yes. If she takes HIV treatment during pregnancy, birth and breastfeeding, and the baby gets preventive medicine and testing, the chance of passing HIV to the baby becomes very small. That is why HIV testing is part of antenatal care.
Umugore utwite ufite virusi itera SIDA ashobora kurinda umwana?

Yego. Iyo afata imiti mu gihe atwite, abyara n'igihe yonsa, kandi umwana agahabwa imiti imurinda n'ibizamini, ibyago byo kwanduza umwana biba bike cyane. Ni yo mpamvu kwipimisha virusi itera SIDA ari kimwe mu bigize kwipimisha inda.
I am living with HIV. How do I tell my partner?

Telling a partner is a personal step and you can take time to prepare. A counsellor at your health centre can help you plan what to say, or tell them with you. Choose a private, calm moment. If you fear violence, talk to the counsellor or Isange (3029) first.
Mfite virusi itera SIDA. Nabwira nte umukunzi wanjye?

Kubwira umukunzi ni intambwe yawe bwite kandi ushobora gufata igihe cyo kwitegura. Umujyanama ku kigo nderabuzima yagufasha gutegura icyo uvuga, cyangwa akabimubwirana nawe. Hitamo igihe kiherereye kandi gituje. Niba utinya ihohoterwa, banza uvugane n'umujyanama cyangwa Isange (3029).
How common is HIV among young people in Rwanda?

Most young people in Rwanda do not have HIV, but new infections among youth remain a concern. About 1.2% of young women and 0.5% of young men aged 15 to 24 are living with HIV, and young people account for around a third of new infections. Condoms, testing, PrEP and PEP help protect you.
Virusi itera SIDA ingana ite mu rubyiruko mu Rwanda?

Urubyiruko rwinshi mu Rwanda ntirufite virusi itera SIDA, ariko ubwandu bushya mu rubyiruko buracyahangayikishije. Nka 1.2% by'abakobwa na 0.5% by'abahungu bafite imyaka 15 kugeza kuri 24 bafite virusi itera SIDA, kandi urubyiruko rubarirwamo nka kimwe cya gatatu cy'ubwandu bushya. Agakingirizo, kwipimisha, PrEP na PEP bigufasha kwirinda.
How do I say no to sex without losing my partner?

You can be kind and clear: 'I like you, but I am not ready for sex.' You do not owe anyone an explanation. Suggest other ways to spend time together. A partner who truly cares will respect your no; if they leave because of it, that tells you about them, not about your worth.
Nakwanga imibonano nte ntatakaje umukunzi wanjye?

Ushobora kuvuga neza kandi bigaragara: 'Ndagukunda, ariko sinditegura imibonano.' Ntugomba gusobanurira umuntu impamvu. Tanga ibindi bitekerezo byo kumarana igihe. Umukunzi ukwitayeho by'ukuri azubaha oya yawe; niba agiye kubera yo, bikwereka uwo ari we, si agaciro kawe.
How do I know if I am ready for sex?

Being ready means you want it for yourself, not because of pressure, you trust and can talk openly with your partner, you both agree, and you know how to prevent pregnancy and STIs. If you feel unsure, scared or pushed, you are not ready, and waiting is always okay.
Namenya nte ko niteguye gukora imibonano?

Kwitegura bisobanura ko ubishaka ku bwawe, atari ukubera igitutu, wizeye kandi ushobora kuganira neza n'umukunzi wawe, mwembi mubyemeranyijeho, kandi uzi uko mwakwirinda inda n'indwara. Niba ufite gushidikanya, ubwoba cyangwa uhatirwa, ntiwiteguye, kandi gutegereza ni byiza buri gihe.
Is it safe to send nude photos to my boyfriend or girlfriend?

It is risky. Once sent, you lose control of a photo: it can be shared, kept after a breakup or used to threaten you. Sharing sexual images of anyone under 18 is a crime. You can always say no. If someone threatens to share your photos, it is not your fault: save the messages and report to RIB on 166 or the GBV line 3512.
Ni byiza koherereza umukunzi wanjye amafoto nambaye ubusa?

Bifite ibyago. Iyo umaze kohereza ifoto, ntuba ukiyigenzura: ishobora gusakazwa, kubikwa nyuma yo gutandukana cyangwa gukoreshwa mu kukukangisha. Gusakaza amashusho y'urukozasoni y'umuntu uri munsi y'imyaka 18 ni icyaha. Ushobora buri gihe kwanga. Niba hari ukangisha gusakaza amafoto yawe, si amakosa yawe: bika ubutumwa kandi ubimenyeshe RIB kuri 166 cyangwa umurongo wo kurwanya ihohoterwa 3512.
Is watching pornography bad for me?

Pornography is not real life: it often shows sex without consent talk or protection and unrealistic bodies. Watching a lot can create pressure and wrong expectations about sex and partners. If it makes you feel bad or you cannot stop, talk to someone you trust or a counsellor.
Kureba filime z'urukozasoni ni bibi kuri njye?

Filime z'urukozasoni si ubuzima nyabwo: akenshi zerekana imibonano nta kwemeranya cyangwa kwirinda, n'imibiri idasanzwe. Kuzireba cyane bishobora gutera igitutu n'ibitekerezo bitari byo ku mibonano n'abakunzi. Niba bigutera kumva nabi cyangwa udashobora kubireka, vugana n'umuntu wizeye cyangwa umujyanama.
We broke up and I feel terrible. How do I cope?

Breakups hurt, and it is normal to feel sad, angry or confused. Talk to friends or family, keep doing things you enjoy, sleep and eat well, and give yourself time. Avoid checking their social media all the time. If sadness lasts weeks or you think of hurting yourself, get help: call 114 or talk to a health worker.
Twatandukanye kandi numva meze nabi cyane. Nakwihangana nte?

Gutandukana birababaza, kandi ni ibisanzwe kumva agahinda, uburakari cyangwa urujijo. Ganira n'inshuti cyangwa umuryango, komeza ukore ibyo ukunda, usinzire kandi urye neza, kandi wihe igihe. Irinde guhora ureba imbuga nkoranyambaga ze. Niba agahinda kamara ibyumweru cyangwa utekereza kwigirira nabi, shaka ubufasha: hamagara 114 cyangwa uvugane n'umukozi w'ubuzima.
Is it safe to meet someone I met online?

Be careful: people online are not always who they say. Do not share your address, school or private photos.
