If you decide to meet, meet in a busy public place during the day, tell a trusted person where you are going, and leave if you feel uncomfortable. Be very cautious of anyone offering money, gifts or jobs.
Ni byiza guhura n'umuntu twamenyaniye kuri interineti?

Witonde: abantu bo kuri interineti si ko buri gihe baba aribo bavuga. Ntutange aho utuye, ishuri wigaho cyangwa amafoto yawe bwite. Niba wahisemo guhura nawe, muhurire ahantu hahurira abantu benshi ku manywa, ubwire umuntu wizeye aho ugiye, kandi ugende niba wumva utisanzuye. Witondere cyane umuntu wese uguha amafaranga, impano cyangwa akazi.
How do I tell someone I like them?

Be yourself and keep it simple, for example: 'I enjoy spending time with you. Would you like to hang out?' Choose a private, relaxed moment. Be ready for any answer: if they say no, respect it, it takes courage to ask and it says nothing bad about you.

Ba uwo uri we kandi bivuge mu buryo bworoshye, urugero: 'Nkunda kumarana igihe nawe. Wakwemera ko twasohokana?' Hitamo igihe kiherereye kandi gituje. Itegure igisubizo icyo ari cyo cyose: niba avuze oya, ubyubahe, kubaza bisaba ubutwari kandi ntibisobanura ko hari ikibi kuri wowe.
I am attracted to people of the same sex. Is something wrong with me?

Nothing is wrong with you. Many young people have questions about attraction, and feelings can become clearer over time. You deserve respect, safety and good health care like everyone else. Talking to someone you trust or a counsellor can help, and health services, including HIV prevention, are for everyone.
Nkururwa n'abantu bahuje igitsina nanjye. Hari ikibazo mfite?

Nta kibazo ufite. Urubyiruko rwinshi rugira ibibazo ku byiyumvo byo gukururwa n'abandi, kandi ibyiyumvo bishobora kugenda bisobanuka uko igihe kigenda. Ukwiye kubahwa, umutekano n'ubuvuzi bwiza nk'abandi bose. Kuganira n'umuntu wizeye cyangwa umujyanama byagufasha, kandi serivisi z'ubuzima, harimo kwirinda virusi itera SIDA, ni iz'abantu bose.
Is it okay to wait until marriage?

Yes. Choosing to wait is a valid and healthy choice, and it is the surest way to avoid pregnancy and STIs. It is still useful to learn about consent, contraception and STIs, so you are ready to protect yourself whenever you decide.

Yego. Guhitamo gutegereza ni amahitamo meza kandi y'ubuzima, kandi ni bwo buryo bwizewe bwo kwirinda inda n'indwara. Ariko ni byiza no kumenya ibijyanye no kwemera, kuboneza urubyaro n'indwara, kugira ngo uzaba witeguye kwirinda igihe cyose uzabihitamo.
My friends push me to drink alcohol at parties. What should I do?

You can say no: 'No thanks, I'm fine.' Alcohol makes it harder to make safe choices about sex and consent and raises the risk of violence. Stay with friends you trust, keep your drink with you, and plan how to get home safely.
Inshuti zanjye zimpatira kunywa inzoga mu birori. Nakora iki?

Ushobora kwanga: 'Oya urakoze, meze neza.' Inzoga zituma bigorana gufata ibyemezo bitekanye ku mibonano no kwemera, kandi zongera ibyago by'ihohoterwa. Guma hamwe n'inshuti wizeye, uhore ufite icyo kunywa cyawe, kandi utegure uko utaha mu mutekano.

Gender-based violence includes physical violence like hitting, sexual violence like rape or unwanted touching, emotional abuse like threats and insults, and economic abuse like taking someone's money or stopping them from working. It is a crime in Rwanda, and help is free: GBV line 3512, Isange 3029, child helpline 116.
Ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina ni iki?

Ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina ririmo ihohoterwa ry'umubiri nko gukubita, ihohoterwa rishingiye ku mibonano nko gufata ku ngufu cyangwa gukorakora umuntu atabishaka, ihohoterwa ryo mu marangamutima nk'iterabwoba no gutukana, n'ihohoterwa rishingiye ku mutungo nko gufata amafaranga y'undi cyangwa kumubuza gukora. Ni icyaha mu Rwanda, kandi ubufasha ni ubuntu: umurongo 3512, Isange 3029, umurongo wo gufasha abana 116.
What should I do to keep evidence after sexual assault?

Your safety and health come first. Go to an Isange One Stop Centre or health facility as soon as possible, ideally within 72 hours. If you can, avoid bathing or changing clothes before, and bring the clothes you wore in a paper or cloth bag. Even if you have washed, still go: you can get medicine to prevent HIV and pregnancy, and free support.
Nakora iki ngo mbike ibimenyetso nyuma yo gufatwa ku ngufu?

Umutekano wawe n'ubuzima bwawe ni byo bibanza. Jya kuri Isange One Stop Centre cyangwa ku kigo cy'ubuzima vuba bishoboka, byiza mu masaha 72. Niba bishoboka, irinde koga cyangwa guhindura imyenda mbere yo kugenda, kandi uzane imyenda wari wambaye mu gafuka k'impapuro cyangwa k'igitambaro. N'iyo waba wogeje, genda: uzahabwa imiti irinda virusi itera SIDA no gutwita, n'ubufasha bw'ubuntu.
A teacher or boss keeps touching me and making sexual comments.

That is sexual harassment and it is not your fault. You have the right to be safe at school and work. Write down what happened and when, tell a trusted adult or the school leadership, and you can report it to RIB on 166, the GBV line 3512 or Isange 3029. If you are under 18, call 116.
Mwarimu cyangwa umukoresha ahora ankorakora kandi ambwira amagambo y'urukozasoni.

Ibyo ni ugutoteza mu buryo bushingiye ku gitsina kandi si amakosa yawe. Ufite uburenganzira bwo kuba utekanye ku ishuri no ku kazi. Andika ibyabaye n'igihe byabereye, ubwire umuntu mukuru wizeye cyangwa ubuyobozi bw'ishuri, kandi ushobora kubimenyesha RIB kuri 166, umurongo wo kurwanya ihohoterwa 3512 cyangwa Isange 3029. Niba uri munsi y'imyaka 18, hamagara 116.
Someone is harassing me online with sexual messages.

This is not your fault and you do not have to reply. Block them, take screenshots of the messages, and report the account on the platform. Tell a trusted adult and report it to RIB on 166 or the GBV line 3512, especially if there are threats or they ask for photos.
Hari umuntu umpoza ku butumwa bw'urukozasoni kuri interineti.

Si amakosa yawe kandi ntugomba kumusubiza. Muhagarike (block), ufate amafoto y'ubutumwa (screenshots), kandi umurege ku rubuga. Bibwire umuntu mukuru wizeye kandi ubimenyeshe RIB kuri 166 cyangwa umurongo wo kurwanya ihohoterwa 3512, cyane cyane niba hari iterabwoba cyangwa agusaba amafoto.
Can boys be victims of sexual abuse too?

Yes. Boys and men can also be sexually abused, and it is never their fault. It does not make anyone less of a man. Help is the same and free: Isange One Stop Centre 3029, child helpline 116 for under 18, or RIB 166.
Abahungu nabo bashobora guhohoterwa mu buryo bushingiye ku mibonano?

Yego. Abahungu n'abagabo nabo bashobora guhohoterwa mu buryo bushingiye ku mibonano, kandi ntabwo ari amakosa yabo. Ntibituma umuntu atakaza ubugabo. Ubufasha ni bumwe kandi ni ubuntu: Isange One Stop Centre 3029, umurongo wo gufasha abana 116 ku bari munsi y'imyaka 18, cyangwa RIB 166.
Someone offered me a job abroad and wants my passport. Is it safe?

Be very careful: fake job offers are a common way people are trafficked. Do not give your passport or ID to anyone, check the company with officials, and talk to your family before accepting. If you suspect trafficking or someone is being held, call RIB on 166 or 112.
Hari umuntu wampaye akazi mu mahanga kandi arashaka pasiporo yanjye. Ni amahoro?

Witonde cyane: akazi k'ibinyoma ni bumwe mu buryo bukunze gukoreshwa mu icuruzwa ry'abantu. Ntuhe umuntu uwo ari we wese pasiporo cyangwa indangamuntu yawe, genzura ikigo n'inzego zibishinzwe, kandi uganire n'umuryango mbere yo kwemera. Niba ukeka icuruzwa ry'abantu cyangwa hari ufungiranywe, hamagara RIB kuri 166 cyangwa 112.
I have sex with someone for money to pay for my needs.

Thank you for sharing this. Many young people face pressure to exchange sex for money or things they need, and you deserve to be safe. These relationships often bring violence, HIV and pregnancy risks. Use condoms every time, ask about PrEP, and know you can get confidential support: child helpline 116 if under 18, Isange 3029, or a youth corner.
Nkora imibonano n'umuntu ngo ampe amafaranga yo kwikemurira ibibazo.

Urakoze kubimbwira. Urubyiruko rwinshi ruhura n'igitutu cyo gukora imibonano rugamije amafaranga cyangwa ibyo rukeneye, kandi ukwiye kugira umutekano. Iyi mibanire ikunze kuzana ihohoterwa, ibyago bya virusi itera SIDA no gutwita. Koresha agakingirizo buri gihe, ubaze ibijyanye na PrEP, kandi umenye ko ushobora kubona ubufasha mu ibanga: umurongo wo gufasha abana 116 niba uri munsi y'imyaka 18, Isange 3029, cyangwa serivisi z'urubyiruko.
What services does Isange One Stop Centre give?

Isange One Stop Centres give free, confidential care to people affected by gender-based violence and child abuse: medical care including medicine to prevent HIV and pregnancy, counselling, police and legal support, and a safe place in some cases. There are 48 centres linked to district and teaching hospitals. Call 3029 toll-free.
Isange One Stop Centre itanga izihe serivisi?

Isange One Stop Centre zitanga ku buntu kandi mu ibanga ubufasha ku bahuye n'ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina no guhohotera abana: ubuvuzi harimo imiti irinda virusi itera SIDA no gutwita, ubujyanama, ubufasha bwa polisi n'ubw'amategeko, n'aho kuba hatekanye mu bihe bimwe. Hari ibigo 48 bifatanye n'ibitaro by'uturere n'ibitaro bikuru. Hamagara 3029 ku buntu.
Sometimes my heart races and I can't breathe and I feel I will die. What is happening?

That sounds like a panic attack, which is frightening but usually passes within minutes and is not dangerous. Breathe slowly: in for 4 counts, hold, out for 6. Name 5 things you can see around you. If it happens often, talk to a health worker or call 114. If you have chest pain or it does not stop, get medical help.
Rimwe na rimwe umutima utera cyane, sinshobora guhumeka kandi nkumva ngiye gupfa. Ni iki kiba?

Ibyo bisa n'igitero cy'ubwoba bukabije (panic attack), giteye ubwoba ariko akenshi gishira mu minota mike kandi si akaga. Humeka buhoro: injiza umwuka ubara kugeza kuri 4, uhagarare gato, usohore ubara kugeza kuri 6. Vuga ibintu 5 ubona hafi yawe. Niba bikunze kubaho, vugana n'umukozi w'ubuzima cyangwa uhamagare 114. Niba uribwa mu gituza cyangwa bidashira, shaka ubuvuzi.
I feel lonely and have no friends.

Feeling lonely is painful and more common than people show. Try small steps: join a club, sport, church or youth group, or talk to one classmate about something you both like. Real friendships take time. If loneliness makes you very sad, talk to a counsellor or call 114.
Numva ndi jyenyine kandi nta nshuti mfite.

Kumva uri wenyine birababaza kandi bikunze kubaho kurusha uko abantu babigaragaza. Gerageza intambwe nto: injira mu itsinda, siporo, urusengero cyangwa ihuriro ry'urubyiruko, cyangwa uganire n'umunyeshuri umwe ku kintu mwese mukunda. Ubucuti nyabwo bufata igihe. Niba kuba wenyine bigutera agahinda kenshi, vugana n'umujyanama cyangwa uhamagare 114.

Many young people feel this way, especially while their bodies change. Your worth is not your looks. Try to limit comparing yourself to filtered photos online, notice what your body can do, and spend time with people who make you feel good. If these thoughts take over or affect eating, talk to a health worker.

Urubyiruko rwinshi rwumva rutyo, cyane cyane igihe umubiri urimo guhinduka. Agaciro kawe si uko usa. Gerageza kugabanya kwigereranya n'amafoto yahinduwe kuri interineti, wite ku byo umubiri wawe ushoboye, kandi umarane igihe n'abantu bagutera kumva umerewe neza. Niba ibi bitekerezo bikurenze cyangwa bikagira ingaruka ku mirire, vugana n'umukozi w'ubuzima.
During commemoration (Kwibuka) I feel very sad and have flashbacks.

Many people feel strong grief, fear or flashbacks during Kwibuka, and you are not alone. Stay with people you trust, rest, and talk about how you feel. Counsellors are available during commemoration, and you can call the RBC health line 114 for free support.
RBC health line 114; AVEGA counselling line 7494
Mu gihe cyo kwibuka numva mfite agahinda kenshi kandi ibyabaye bikangarukamo.

Abantu benshi bagira agahinda gakomeye, ubwoba cyangwa ihungabana mu gihe cyo Kwibuka, kandi nturi wenyine. Guma hamwe n'abantu wizeye, uruhuke, kandi uvuge uko wiyumva. Abajyanama barahari mu gihe cyo kwibuka, kandi ushobora guhamagara umurongo wa RBC 114 ku buntu ukabona ubufasha.
My friend says she wants to kill herself. What should I do?

Take it seriously. Stay with her, listen without judging, and tell her you care. Do not keep it secret: tell a trusted adult now. If she is in immediate danger, call 112 or take her to the nearest health centre or hospital. You can also call 114 for advice.
Inshuti yanjye ivuga ko ishaka kwiyahura. Nakora iki?

Bifate nk'ibikomeye. Guma hamwe nawe, umutege amatwi utamucira urubanza, kandi umubwire ko umwitayeho. Ntubigire ibanga: bibwire umuntu mukuru wizeye nonaha. Niba ari mu kaga ako kanya, hamagara 112 cyangwa umujyane ku kigo nderabuzima cyangwa ibitaro bikwegereye. Ushobora no guhamagara 114 ukagirwa inama.
Where can I talk to a counsellor?

You can talk to a counsellor at your health centre, a school counsellor or patron, or call the RBC health line 114 for free. Isange One Stop Centres (3029) have counsellors for people affected by violence. Talking to someone is a sign of strength.

Ushobora kuganira n'umujyanama ku kigo nderabuzima, umujyanama w'ishuri cyangwa umurezi, cyangwa ugahamagara umurongo wa RBC 114 ku buntu. Isange One Stop Centre (3029) zifite abajyanama ku bahuye n'ihohoterwa. Kuganira n'umuntu ni ikimenyetso cy'imbaraga.
I can't sleep at night because I think too much.

Try a routine: go to bed and wake up at the same time, put your phone away an hour before sleep, avoid coffee and energy drinks late, and write down your worries before bed. If poor sleep lasts weeks or comes with sadness, talk to a health worker.

Gerageza gahunda: uryame kandi ubyuke ku masaha amwe, ushyire telefone kure isaha imwe mbere yo kuryama, wirinde ikawa n'ibinyobwa byongera imbaraga nijoro, kandi wandike impungenge zawe mbere yo kuryama. Niba kudasinzira bimara ibyumweru cyangwa bikazana agahinda, vugana n'umukozi w'ubuzima.
The hymen shows whether a girl is a virgin.

Myth. The hymen is a thin, stretchy tissue that varies from girl to girl. It can stretch from sport or using tampons, and many girls do not bleed the first time they have sex. No test can prove virginity, and so-called virginity tests are harmful.
Akarangabusugi kerekana niba umukobwa ari isugi.

Si byo. Akarangabusugi ni agahu koroshye kandi kagurumbuka, gatandukana ku mukobwa ku wundi. Gashobora kugurumbuka kubera siporo cyangwa gukoresha tampon, kandi abakobwa benshi ntibava amaraso ku nshuro ya mbere bakora imibonano. Nta kizamini gishobora kwemeza ubusugi, kandi ibyitwa ibizamini by'ubusugi bigira ingaruka mbi.
Myth. Masturbation does not cause infertility, madness, weakness, blindness or small genitals. It is a normal behaviour.
Si byo. Kwikinisha ntibitera ubugumba, ubusazi, intege nke, ubuhumyi cyangwa igitsina gito. Ni imyitwarire isanzwe.
Menstrual blood is dirty or can be used for witchcraft.
Myth. Menstrual blood is normal blood and tissue from the uterus. It is not dirty, dangerous or magical. Girls should never be ashamed of their periods.
Amaraso y'imihango ni umwanda cyangwa ashobora gukoreshwa mu burozi.
Si byo. Amaraso y'imihango ni amaraso asanzwe n'uturemangingo biva muri nyababyeyi. Si umwanda, si akaga kandi nta bupfumu afite. Abakobwa ntibakwiye na rimwe kugira isoni z'imihango.
Eating certain foods or drinking something prevents pregnancy.
Myth. No food, drink, herb or soda prevents pregnancy. Only modern methods like condoms, pills, injections, implants, IUDs and emergency pills work.
Kurya ibiryo runaka cyangwa kunywa ikintu birinda gutwita.
Si byo. Nta biryo, ikinyobwa, imiti gakondo cyangwa soda birinda gutwita. Uburyo bwa kijyambere nk'udukingirizo, ibinini, inshinge, agapira, IUD n'ibinini byihutirwa ni bwo bukora.
Only people with many partners get STIs.
Myth. Anyone who has sex can get an STI, even with one partner, because many infections have no symptoms. Condoms and testing protect everyone.
Abafite abakunzi benshi ni bo bonyine barwara indwara zandurira mu mibonano.
Si byo. Umuntu wese ukora imibonano ashobora kwandura indwara, n'iyo yaba afite umukunzi umwe, kuko indwara nyinshi nta bimenyetso zigaragaza. Udukingirizo no kwipimisha birinda buri wese.
Myth. Circumcision lowers HIV risk but does not prevent it fully, and it does not prevent pregnancy or most other STIs. Condoms are still needed.
Si byo. Gusiramurwa bigabanya ibyago bya virusi itera SIDA ariko ntibiyirinda burundu, kandi ntibirinda gutwita cyangwa izindi ndwara nyinshi. Udukingirizo turacyakenewe.
Sex during pregnancy harms the baby.

Mostly a myth. In a normal pregnancy, sex does not harm the baby, which is protected inside the womb. A health worker may advise avoiding sex if there is bleeding, leaking fluid or other complications. Condoms still protect against STIs.
Imibonano mu gihe cyo gutwita igira ingaruka ku mwana.

Akenshi si byo. Mu gutwita gusanzwe, imibonano ntigira ingaruka ku mwana, urinzwe imbere muri nyababyeyi. Umukozi w'ubuzima ashobora kugira inama yo kwirinda imibonano niba hari kuva amaraso, amazi ava cyangwa ibindi bibazo. Udukingirizo turacyarinda indwara.
The implant can move around the body or get lost.
Myth. The implant stays where it is placed under the skin of the arm. In very rare cases it moves slightly, and a health worker can find and remove it.
Agapira ko mu kuboko gashobora kugenda mu mubiri cyangwa kakabura.
Si byo. Agapira kaguma aho kashyizwe munsi y'uruhu rw'ukuboko. Ni gake cyane kigira hirya gato, kandi umukozi w'ubuzima ashobora kukabona akakakuramo.
Contraceptives cause birth defects or cancer.
Myth. Modern contraceptives do not cause birth defects, and they do not cause cancer; some even lower the risk of certain cancers. They are among the most studied medicines in the world.
Uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro butera ubumuga ku mwana cyangwa kanseri.

Si byo. Uburyo bwa kijyambere bwo kuboneza urubyaro ntibutera ubumuga ku bana, kandi ntibutera kanseri; bumwe ndetse bugabanya ibyago bya kanseri zimwe. Ni imwe mu miti yakorewe ubushakashatsi bwinshi ku isi.
What does Rwanda's new health law mean for young people?

Law N° 026/2025 regulating healthcare services, in force since 18 September 2025, lowers the age to consent to health services, including sexual and reproductive health, from 18 to 15. This means people aged 15 and above can get services like contraception and HIV prevention without parental or third-party consent.
Itegeko rishya ry'ubuzima mu Rwanda rivuze iki ku rubyiruko?

Itegeko N° 026/2025 rigenga serivisi z'ubuvuzi, ritangira gukurikizwa kuva ku wa 18 Nzeri 2025, ryamanuye imyaka yo kwiyemerera serivisi z'ubuzima, harimo n'iz'imyororokere, kuva kuri 18 kugeza kuri 15. Ibi bivuze ko abafite imyaka 15 kuzamura bashobora guhabwa serivisi nko kuboneza urubyaro no kwirinda virusi itera SIDA batabanje gusaba uruhushya rw'ababyeyi cyangwa undi muntu.
Will the health worker tell my parents or school?

Health workers must keep your health information confidential. If you are 15 or older, you can get sexual and reproductive health services on your own. The exception is when you are in danger, for example abuse, where they may involve protection services to keep you safe. You can ask the health worker what will be shared before you talk.
Umukozi w'ubuzima azabibwira ababyeyi banjye cyangwa ishuri?

Abakozi b'ubuzima bagomba kugira ibanga amakuru y'ubuzima bwawe. Niba ufite imyaka 15 cyangwa irenga, ushobora guhabwa serivisi z'ubuzima bw'imyororokere ku giti cyawe. Bitandukanye ni igihe uri mu kaga, urugero nk'ihohoterwa, aho bashobora kwitabaza inzego zishinzwe kurinda kugira ngo bakurinde. Ushobora kubaza umukozi w'ubuzima ibizasangizwa abandi mbere yo kuvuga.

A youth corner, or youth-friendly service, is a space at many health centres and youth centres where young people can get information and services such as counselling, contraception, condoms, HIV testing and STI care, from staff trained to welcome youth without judgement.

Youth corner, cyangwa serivisi zinogeye urubyiruko, ni ahantu ku bigo nderabuzima byinshi no mu bigo by'urubyiruko urubyiruko rushobora kubona amakuru na serivisi nk'ubujyanama, kuboneza urubyaro, udukingirizo, kwipimisha virusi itera SIDA no kuvurwa indwara zandurira mu mibonano, bitangwa n'abakozi bahuguriwe kwakira urubyiruko nta kurucira urubanza.
What helpline numbers can I call in Rwanda?

Emergency (police, danger): 112. Health call centre, including mental health support: 114, toll-free. Isange One Stop Centre for violence: 3029, toll-free. GBV line: 3512. Child helpline for under 18: 116, toll-free. RIB: 166.
Ni izihe nimero z'ubufasha nahamagara mu Rwanda?

Ibyihutirwa (polisi, akaga): 112. Umurongo w'ubuzima, harimo n'ubufasha ku buzima bwo mu mutwe: 114, ni ubuntu. Isange One Stop Centre ku ihohoterwa: 3029, ni ubuntu. Umurongo wo kurwanya ihohoterwa: 3512. Umurongo wo gufasha abana bari munsi y'imyaka 18: 116, ni ubuntu. RIB: 166.
A health worker judged me when I asked for condoms. What can I do?

You have the right to respectful and confidential care. That experience was not okay. You can ask to see another provider, go to a youth corner, or use a pharmacy. You can also tell the health centre's management about what happened.
Umukozi w'ubuzima yancira urubanza mbajije udukingirizo. Nakora iki?

Ufite uburenganzira bwo kwitabwaho mu cyubahiro no mu ibanga. Ibyo wahuye nabyo ntibikwiye. Ushobora gusaba kwakirwa n'undi mukozi, ukajya kuri serivisi z'urubyiruko, cyangwa ugakoresha farumasi. Ushobora kandi kubimenyesha ubuyobozi bw'ikigo nderabuzima.
Do young people with disabilities have the same sexual health rights?

Yes. Young people with disabilities have the same rights to information, relationships, contraception, HIV care and protection from violence. Health services should be accessible, including communication support. If services are not accessible, ask for help or report it to the health facility.
Urubyiruko rufite ubumuga rufite uburenganzira bumwe ku buzima bw'imyororokere?

Yego. Urubyiruko rufite ubumuga rufite uburenganzira bumwe bwo kubona amakuru, gukundana, kuboneza urubyaro, kuvurwa virusi itera SIDA no kurindwa ihohoterwa. Serivisi z'ubuzima zigomba kugerwaho n'abantu bose, harimo ubufasha mu itumanaho. Niba serivisi zitakugeraho, saba ubufasha cyangwa ubimenyeshe ikigo cy'ubuzima.
I haven't been feeling well for some days.

I'm sorry you're not feeling well. It helps to know more: is it your body, like pain, fever, bleeding or discharge, or your feelings, like sadness, stress or worry? If you have fever, strong pain or bleeding, please go to a health centre. You can also talk to a health worker or call the free line 114.

Mbabajwe no kumva ko utameze neza. Byamfasha kumenya byinshi: ni umubiri, nk'uburibwe, umuriro, kuva amaraso cyangwa amatembabuzi, cyangwa ni amarangamutima, nk'agahinda, stress cyangwa impungenge? Niba ufite umuriro, uburibwe bukabije cyangwa uva amaraso, jya ku kigo nderabuzima. Ushobora no kuvugana n'umukozi w'ubuzima cyangwa guhamagara umurongo w'ubuntu 114.
I don't want to call anyone or get help.

I hear you, and it's okay if you don't want to call right now. I'm still here. Is there someone you trust nearby, a friend or family member, you could tell that you're not okay and ask to stay with you? Writing down what you feel can also help. If you feel you might hurt yourself now, please call 112 or go to the nearest health centre.
Sinshaka guhamagara umuntu cyangwa gushaka ubufasha.

Ndakumva, kandi nta kibazo niba udashaka guhamagara ubu. Ndacyari hano. Ese hari umuntu wizeye uri hafi yawe, inshuti cyangwa uwo mu muryango, wabwira ko utameze neza ukamusaba kuguma nawe? Kwandika uko wiyumva nabyo bishobora gufasha. Niba wumva ushobora kwigirira nabi ubu, hamagara 112 cyangwa ujye ku kigo nderabuzima kikwegereye.
I get erections at random times, even in class. Is that normal?

Yes. During puberty, hormones cause erections often and sometimes for no reason, even when you are not thinking about sex. It is normal and usually goes away in a few minutes. Thinking about something else, or sitting with a book on your lap, helps.
Igitsina cyanjye gihagarara nta mpamvu, ndetse no mu ishuri. Ni ibisanzwe?

Yego. Mu bugimbi, imisemburo ituma igitsina gihagarara kenshi kandi rimwe na rimwe nta mpamvu, n'iyo udatekereza ku mibonano. Ni ibisanzwe kandi akenshi bishira mu minota mike. Gutekereza ku kindi kintu, cyangwa kwicara ushyize igitabo ku bibero, bifasha.
I have sudden, very strong pain in my testicle.

Sudden severe pain in a testicle can be a twisted testicle, which needs surgery within hours to save it. Go to the nearest hospital or health centre immediately, or call 112. Do not wait to see if it goes away.
Mfite uburibwe butunguranye kandi bukabije mu gasabo k'intanga (ubugabo).

Uburibwe butunguranye kandi bukabije mu gasabo k'intanga bushobora guterwa no kwihotora kwako, bikeneye kubagwa mu masaha make kugira ngo karokorwe. Jya ku bitaro cyangwa ku kigo nderabuzima bikwegereye ako kanya, cyangwa uhamagare 112. Ntutegereze ngo urebe niba bishira.
One of my testicles is bigger or hangs lower. Is that normal?
Yes. It is very common for one testicle to be slightly bigger or to hang lower than the other. See a health worker if you notice a new lump, swelling, heaviness or pain.
Kimwe mu bice by'agasabo k'intanga kiruta ikindi cyangwa kimanutse cyane. Ni ibisanzwe?
Yego. Birasanzwe cyane ko intanga imwe iba nini gato cyangwa ikamanuka kurusha indi. Jya kwa muganga niba ubonye ikibyimba gishya, kubyimba, uburemere cyangwa uburibwe.
I come too quickly during sex. What can I do?

Coming quickly is common, especially for young men and in new relationships, and often improves with time and less anxiety. Slowing down, relaxing and talking with your partner help. If it continues to worry you, a health worker can advise privately.
Nsohora vuba cyane mu mibonano. Nakora iki?

Gusohora vuba birasanzwe, cyane cyane ku basore no mu rukundo rushya, kandi akenshi bigenda bigabanuka uko igihe kigenda n'impungenge zigabanuka. Kugenda buhoro, gutuza no kuganira n'umukunzi wawe bifasha. Niba bikomeje kuguhangayikisha, umukozi w'ubuzima yakugira inama mu ibanga.
Sometimes I can't get or keep an erection. Is something wrong?

This happens to most men at some point and is often caused by stress, nerves, tiredness, alcohol or drugs. If it happens often, a health worker can check for other causes. Avoid buying pills from unofficial sellers, as they can be dangerous.
Rimwe na rimwe igitsina cyanjye ntigihagarara cyangwa ntigitinda guhagarara. Hari ikibazo mfite?

Ibi bibaho ku bagabo benshi igihe runaka kandi akenshi biterwa n'umunaniro w'ibitekerezo, ubwoba, umunaniro, inzoga cyangwa ibiyobyabwenge. Niba bibaho kenshi, umukozi w'ubuzima yasuzuma izindi mpamvu. Irinde kugura ibinini ku bacuruzi batemewe, kuko bishobora guteza akaga.
There is pus or discharge coming from my penis.

Discharge from the penis, often with burning when you pee, is usually a sign of an STI such as gonorrhoea or chlamydia. Go to a health centre for testing and treatment, avoid sex until treated, and your partner should be treated too.
Hari amashyira cyangwa ibindi bisohoka mu gitsina cyanjye.

Ibisohoka mu gitsina cy'umugabo, akenshi biherekejwe no kokera iyo anyara, akenshi ni ikimenyetso cy'indwara yandurira mu mibonano nk'imitezi cyangwa chlamydia. Jya ku kigo nderabuzima wipimishe kandi uvurwe, wirinde imibonano kugeza uvuwe, kandi umukunzi wawe nawe agomba kuvurwa.
How do I keep my penis clean if I am not circumcised?

Wash daily with clean water. Gently pull back the foreskin as far as it goes comfortably, wash underneath, rinse and pull it back down. Never force it. If it is tight, painful or swollen, see a health worker.
Nasukura nte igitsina cyanjye niba ntarasiramuwe?

Karaba buri munsi ukoresheje amazi meza. Subiza inyuma uruhu rutwikiriye umutwe w'igitsina buhoro buhoro aho rugarukira nta kubabara, woze munsi yarwo, wiyuhagire hanyuma urusubize aho rwari ruri. Ntukarukurure ku ngufu. Niba rufunze cyane, rubabaza cyangwa rubyimba, jya kwa muganga.
Is it okay for boys to cry or talk about their feelings?

Yes. Boys and men have feelings too, and talking about them is a sign of strength, not weakness. Keeping everything inside can lead to stress, anger or sadness. Talk to a friend, family member, teacher or counsellor, or call the free line 114.
Ni byiza ko abahungu barira cyangwa bavuga ku byiyumvo byabo?

Yego. Abahungu n'abagabo nabo bagira ibyiyumvo, kandi kubivuga ni ikimenyetso cy'imbaraga, si intege nke. Kubika byose imbere bishobora gutera umunaniro, uburakari cyangwa agahinda. Vugana n'inshuti, uwo mu muryango, mwarimu cyangwa umujyanama, cyangwa uhamagare umurongo w'ubuntu 114.
How do I check my testicles?

Once a month, after a warm bath, gently roll each testicle between your fingers. Get to know how they normally feel. If you find a hard lump, swelling or a change in size, see a health worker. Most lumps are not cancer, but it is best to check early.

Rimwe mu kwezi, nyuma yo kwiyuhagira amazi ashyushye, kungura buhoro buri bya hagati y'intoki. Menya uko asanzwe ameze. Niba ubonye ikibyimba gikomeye, kubyimba cyangwa impinduka mu ngano, jya kwa muganga. Ibibyimba byinshi si kanseri, ariko ni byiza gusuzuma hakiri kare.
Is it normal for semen to look different sometimes?
Yes. Semen is usually white or greyish and can be thicker or thinner from day to day. See a health worker if it is red or brown, smells bad, or comes with pain, as that can be a sign of infection.
Ni ibisanzwe ko intanga zisa ukundi rimwe na rimwe?

Yego. Amasohoro akenshi aba yera cyangwa asa n'ikijuju kandi ashobora kuba afatanye cyangwa yoroshye bitewe n'umunsi. Jya kwa muganga niba atukura cyangwa asa n'ikigina, anuka nabi, cyangwa aherekejwe n'uburibwe, kuko bishobora kuba ikimenyetso cy'indwara.
Before my period I feel moody, bloated and tired. Why?

Many girls get premenstrual symptoms a few days before their period, such as mood changes, bloating, sore breasts, tiredness or spots, caused by hormone changes. Sleep, exercise, water and eating regularly help. If symptoms are severe or stop your daily life, see a health worker.
Mbere y'imihango numva mpindagurika mu byiyumvo, inda ikabyimba kandi nkananirwa. Kuki?

Abakobwa benshi bagira ibimenyetso bibanziriza imihango mu minsi mike mbere yayo, nko guhindagurika mu byiyumvo, kubyimba inda, amabere ababara, umunaniro cyangwa ibiheri, biterwa n'impinduka z'imisemburo. Gusinzira, imyitozo, amazi no kurya neza bifasha. Niba ibimenyetso bikabije cyangwa bikubuza ibikorwa bya buri munsi, jya kwa muganga.
I bleed between my periods. Is that a problem?

Light spotting between periods can happen with a new contraceptive method, around ovulation or in the first years of periods. But bleeding after sex, heavy bleeding, or bleeding with pain or bad-smelling discharge should be checked by a health worker. If you could be pregnant, take a pregnancy test.
Nva amaraso hagati y'imihango ibiri. Ni ikibazo?

Kuva amaraso make hagati y'imihango bishobora kubaho iyo watangiye uburyo bushya bwo kuboneza urubyaro, mu gihe cy'irekurwa ry'igi cyangwa mu myaka ya mbere y'imihango. Ariko kuva amaraso nyuma y'imibonano, amaraso menshi, cyangwa amaraso aherekejwe n'uburibwe cyangwa amatembabuzi anuka bikwiye gusuzumwa n'umukozi w'ubuzima. Niba ushobora kuba utwite, kora ikizamini cyo gutwita.
My period pain is so strong that painkillers don't help.

Very strong period pain that stops you from school or work, or is not helped by painkillers, should be checked. It can be caused by conditions like endometriosis, which can be treated. Go to a health centre and describe exactly how the pain affects you.
Uburibwe bw'imihango ni bwinshi cyane ku buryo imiti igabanya ububabare idafasha.

Uburibwe bukabije bw'imihango bukubuza kujya ku ishuri cyangwa ku kazi, cyangwa budafashwa n'imiti igabanya ububabare, bukwiye gusuzumwa. Bushobora guterwa n'indwara nka endometriose, ivurwa. Jya ku kigo nderabuzima usobanure neza uko uburibwe bukugiraho ingaruka.
What can I take for period cramps?

A hot water bottle on your belly, gentle exercise and rest often help. Common painkillers from a pharmacy, such as paracetamol or ibuprofen, can reduce cramps; follow the dose on the package or ask the pharmacist. If pain is severe, see a health worker.
Nafata iki kugira ngo ngabanye uburibwe bw'imihango?

Gushyira icupa ry'amazi ashyushye ku nda, imyitozo yoroheje n'ikiruhuko akenshi bifasha. Imiti isanzwe igabanya ububabare igurwa muri farumasi, nka paracetamol cyangwa ibuprofen, ishobora kugabanya uburibwe; kurikiza urugero ruri ku gapaki cyangwa ubaze umufarumasiye. Niba uburibwe bukabije, jya kwa muganga.
My periods are very irregular and I have a lot of acne and body hair.

Irregular periods together with acne and extra hair on the face or body can be signs of a hormone condition such as PCOS. It is common and can be managed. See a health worker, who can check and advise on treatment.
Imihango yanjye ihindagurika cyane kandi mfite ibiheri byinshi n'ubwoya bwinshi ku mubiri.

Imihango ihindagurika cyane hamwe n'ibiheri n'ubwoya bwinshi mu maso cyangwa ku mubiri bishobora kuba ibimenyetso by'ikibazo cy'imisemburo nka PCOS. Birasanzwe kandi bishobora kwitabwaho. Jya kwa muganga agusuzume kandi akugire inama ku buvuzi.
Can a girl who has never had sex use a menstrual cup or tampon?

Yes. Using a menstrual cup or tampon does not affect virginity, which is about sexual experience, not the body. Start with a small size, relax, and follow the instructions. If it hurts, stop and try again later or use pads.
Umukobwa utarakora imibonano ashobora gukoresha menstrual cup cyangwa tampon?

Yego. Gukoresha menstrual cup cyangwa tampon ntibigira ingaruka ku busugi, kuko ubusugi bujyanye no gukora imibonano, si umubiri. Tangira n'ingano nto, utuze, kandi ukurikize amabwiriza. Niba bikubabaza, hagarara wongere ugerageze nyuma cyangwa ukoreshe cotex.
How do I throw away used pads?

Wrap the used pad in paper or its wrapper and put it in a covered bin or latrine. Do not flush it in a toilet, as it can block pipes. Wash your hands afterwards. Reusable pads should be washed with soap and dried in the sun.

Pfunyika cotex wakoresheje mu mpapuro cyangwa mu gapfunyika kayo uyishyire mu kimpoteri gipfundikiye cyangwa mu musarane. Ntuyirohe mu musarane w'amazi, kuko ishobora kuwufunga. Karaba intoki nyuma. Cotex zongera gukoreshwa zimeswa n'isabune zikumishirizwa ku zuba.
I feel dizzy and weak during my period.

Feeling a little tired is common, but dizziness and weakness can be signs of low iron (anaemia), especially if periods are heavy. Eat iron-rich foods like beans, green vegetables, eggs and meat, and drink water. If you faint, feel very weak or bleed heavily, see a health worker.
Numva nzunguye kandi mfite intege nke mu gihe cy'imihango.

Kumva unaniwe gato birasanzwe, ariko kuzungera n'intege nke bishobora kuba ibimenyetso byo kubura amaraso (anemia), cyane cyane niba imihango ari myinshi. Rya ibiryo bikungahaye kuri fer nk'ibishyimbo, imboga z'icyatsi, amagi n'inyama, kandi unywe amazi. Niba uguye igihumure, ufite intege nke cyane cyangwa uva amaraso menshi, jya kwa muganga.
What should I eat when I am pregnant?

Eat a variety of foods every day: beans and other proteins, vegetables, fruits, grains, and milk or eggs if possible. Take the iron and folic acid tablets given at antenatal care. Drink clean water, and avoid alcohol and smoking.

Rya ibiryo bitandukanye buri munsi: ibishyimbo n'ibindi bikungahaye kuri poroteyine, imboga, imbuto, ibinyampeke, n'amata cyangwa amagi niba bishoboka. Fata ibinini bya fer na acide folique uhabwa mu kwipimisha inda. Nywa amazi meza, kandi wirinde inzoga n'itabi.
Can I drink alcohol or smoke while pregnant?

No. Alcohol and smoking can harm the baby's growth and brain and increase the risk of miscarriage and early birth. There is no safe amount of alcohol in pregnancy. If you find it hard to stop, a health worker can help.
Nshobora kunywa inzoga cyangwa itabi ntwite?

Oya. Inzoga n'itabi bishobora kwangiza imikurire n'ubwonko bw'umwana kandi bikongera ibyago byo gukuramo inda no kubyara igihe kitageze. Nta rugero rw'inzoga rutagira ingaruka mu gihe cyo gutwita. Niba bikugora kubireka, umukozi w'ubuzima yagufasha.
I feel sick and tired in early pregnancy. Is that normal?

Yes. Nausea, vomiting, tiredness, sore breasts and needing to pee more are common in the first months. Eat small meals often and rest. If you cannot keep any food or water down, lose weight or feel very weak, go to a health centre.
Ndumva iseseme kandi ndananiwe mu ntangiriro yo gutwita. Ni ibisanzwe?

Yego. Iseseme, kuruka, umunaniro, amabere ababara no kunyara kenshi birasanzwe mu mezi ya mbere. Rya ibiryo bike kenshi kandi uruhuke. Niba nta biryo cyangwa amazi biguma mu nda, ugatakaza ibiro cyangwa ukumva ufite intege nke cyane, jya ku kigo nderabuzima.
Why should I give birth at a health facility?

Health workers can handle problems that can happen suddenly during birth, like heavy bleeding or a baby who struggles to breathe. Giving birth at a health centre or hospital is safer for you and your baby. Plan ahead how you will get there when labour starts.
Kuki nkwiye kubyarira ku kigo cy'ubuzima?

Abakozi b'ubuzima bashobora gukemura ibibazo bishobora kuvuka bitunguranye mu kubyara, nko kuva amaraso menshi cyangwa umwana ugorwa no guhumeka. Kubyarira ku kigo nderabuzima cyangwa ku bitaro bitekanye kuri wowe n'umwana. Tegura mbere uko uzagerayo igihe ibise bitangiye.
Since my baby was born I feel very sad and can't cope.

Many new mothers feel low for a few days after birth, but sadness that lasts more than two weeks, or makes it hard to care for yourself or your baby, may be postnatal depression. It is common and treatable. Talk to a health worker or call 114. If you think of harming yourself or your baby, get help immediately: call 112.
Kuva nabyara numva mfite agahinda kenshi kandi sinshobora kubyihanganira.

Ababyeyi benshi bakimara kubyara bumva bacitse intege iminsi mike, ariko agahinda kamara ibyumweru birenga bibiri, cyangwa gatuma bigorana kwiyitaho cyangwa kwita ku mwana, gashobora kuba agahinda gakabije nyuma yo kubyara. Birasanzwe kandi bivurwa. Vugana n'umukozi w'ubuzima cyangwa uhamagare 114. Niba utekereza kwigirira nabi cyangwa kugirira nabi umwana, shaka ubufasha ako kanya: hamagara 112.
How long should I breastfeed my baby?

Give only breast milk for the first 6 months, with no water or other foods, then add other foods and continue breastfeeding up to 2 years or beyond. Breast milk protects the baby from illness. A health worker can help if breastfeeding is painful or difficult.
Nkwiye konsa umwana igihe kingana iki?

Ha umwana amashereka gusa mu mezi 6 ya mbere, nta mazi cyangwa ibindi biryo, hanyuma wongereho ibindi biryo ariko ukomeze konsa kugeza ku myaka 2 cyangwa irenga. Amashereka arinda umwana indwara. Umukozi w'ubuzima yagufasha niba konsa bikubabaza cyangwa bikugora.
After giving birth, when can I get pregnant again?

You can get pregnant again before your period returns, sometimes within weeks after birth if not breastfeeding fully. Waiting at least 2 years before the next pregnancy is healthier for you and the baby. Ask about a family planning method soon after birth; many are safe while breastfeeding.
Nyuma yo kubyara, nshobora kongera gutwita ryari?

Ushobora kongera gutwita mbere y'uko imihango igaruka, rimwe na rimwe mu byumweru bike nyuma yo kubyara niba utonsa neza gusa. Gutegereza nibura imyaka 2 mbere y'indi nda ni byiza ku buzima bwawe n'ubw'umwana. Baza ibijyanye no kuboneza urubyaro vuba nyuma yo kubyara; uburyo bwinshi ntibugira ingaruka mu gihe wonsa.
My pregnancy test is negative but my period hasn't come.

A test done too early can be negative even if you are pregnant. Wait a week and test again, using first morning urine. If it is still negative and your period hasn't come, stress, weight changes or hormones may be the cause; see a health worker if it continues.
Ikizamini cyo gutwita kigaragaza ko ntatwite ariko imihango ntiraza.

Ikizamini gikozwe kare cyane gishobora kugaragaza ko udatwite n'iyo waba utwite. Tegereza icyumweru wongere wipimishe, ukoresheje inkari za mu gitondo. Niba bikomeza kugaragaza ko udatwite kandi imihango itaraza, umunaniro w'ibitekerezo, guhinduka kw'ibiro cyangwa imisemburo bishobora kuba impamvu; jya kwa muganga niba bikomeje.
I am pregnant and have strong pain on one side of my belly.

Strong pain on one side of the lower belly in early pregnancy, especially with bleeding, dizziness or shoulder pain, can be an ectopic pregnancy, which is a medical emergency. Go to the nearest hospital immediately or call 112.
Ndatwite kandi mfite uburibwe bukabije ku ruhande rumwe rw'inda.

Uburibwe bukabije ku ruhande rumwe rw'inda yo hasi mu ntangiriro yo gutwita, cyane cyane buherekejwe no kuva amaraso, kuzungera cyangwa kuribwa mu rutugu, bushobora kuba inda yafashe hanze ya nyababyeyi, ikaba ari ikibazo cyihutirwa. Jya ku bitaro bikwegereye ako kanya cyangwa uhamagare 112.
I am worried I can't have children. When should I see a doctor?

Most young people can have children. If you have been trying to get pregnant with regular sex and no contraception for 12 months, both partners should see a health worker. Untreated STIs are a common cause of infertility, so testing and treatment protect your future fertility.
Mfite impungenge ko ntazabyara. Nkwiye kujya kwa muganga ryari?

Urubyiruko rwinshi rushobora kubyara. Niba mumaze amezi 12 mugerageza gutwita mukora imibonano kenshi nta buryo bwo kuboneza urubyaro, mwembi mukwiye kujya kwa muganga. Indwara zandurira mu mibonano zitavuwe ni imwe mu mpamvu zikunze gutera ubugumba, bityo kwipimisha no kwivuza birinda ubushobozi bwawe bwo kubyara.
How does alcohol affect decisions about sex?

Alcohol makes it harder to think clearly, so people are more likely to have sex they didn't plan, skip condoms, or be pressured or forced. A person who is very drunk cannot give consent. If you drink, stay with friends you trust and plan how to get home safely.
Inzoga zigira izihe ngaruka ku byemezo bijyanye n'imibonano?

Inzoga zituma bigorana gutekereza neza, bityo abantu bakaba bakora imibonano batateguye, bakirengagiza agakingirizo, cyangwa bagahatirwa. Umuntu wasinze cyane ntashobora kwemera imibonano. Niba unywa, guma hamwe n'inshuti wizeye kandi utegure uko utaha mu mutekano.

No. Using, buying, selling or growing cannabis for personal use is illegal in Rwanda and can lead to arrest. Cannabis can also harm memory, learning and mental health, especially in young people whose brains are still developing.

Oya. Gukoresha, kugura, kugurisha cyangwa guhinga urumogi ku giti cyawe ni icyaha mu Rwanda kandi bishobora gutuma ufungwa. Urumogi rushobora kandi kwangiza kwibuka, kwiga n'ubuzima bwo mu mutwe, cyane cyane ku rubyiruko ubwonko bwarwo bukiri gukura.
What does smoking cannabis do to young people?

Cannabis can affect memory, concentration and school performance, and can trigger anxiety, paranoia or serious mental illness in some young people. Regular use can lead to dependence. If you want to stop or reduce, a health worker or the free line 114 can help.
Kunywa urumogi bigira izihe ngaruka ku rubyiruko?

Urumogi rushobora kugira ingaruka ku kwibuka, ku kwita ku bintu no ku musaruro w'amashuri, kandi rushobora gutera guhangayika, kugira ubwoba budasobanutse cyangwa uburwayi bwo mu mutwe bukomeye ku rubyiruko rumwe. Kurukoresha kenshi bishobora gutera kurubatwa. Niba ushaka kurureka cyangwa kugabanya, umukozi w'ubuzima cyangwa umurongo w'ubuntu 114 bagufasha.
My friend drank too much and won't wake up.

This could be alcohol poisoning, which can kill. Call 112 now. Do not leave them alone. Turn them on their side so they don't choke if they vomit, keep them warm, and do not give them more alcohol, coffee or a cold shower.
Inshuti yanjye yanyoye inzoga nyinshi kandi ntibyuka.

Ibi bishobora kuba uburozi buturuka ku nzoga, bushobora kwica. Hamagara 112 nonaha. Ntumusige wenyine. Muryamishe ku ruhande kugira ngo atanigwa naruka, umushyushye, kandi ntumuhe izindi nzoga, ikawa cyangwa ngo umwoze amazi akonje.
I want to stop drinking but I can't.

Wanting to stop is an important first step. Try setting small goals, avoiding places and friends linked to drinking, and telling someone you trust. Health centres in Rwanda treat alcohol problems, and you can call the free line 114 for support. You don't have to do it alone.

Gushaka kureka ni intambwe ya mbere y'ingenzi. Gerageza kwishyiriraho intego nto, kwirinda ahantu n'inshuti bijyanye no kunywa, no kubwira umuntu wizeye. Ibigo nderabuzima mu Rwanda bivura ibibazo by'inzoga, kandi ushobora guhamagara umurongo w'ubuntu 114 ukabona ubufasha. Ntugomba kubikora wenyine.
How can I protect myself from drinks being spiked?

Keep your drink with you, accept drinks only from people you trust or that you see opened, and don't leave a drink unattended. Stay with friends. If you suddenly feel very drunk, confused or sleepy, tell a friend immediately and get to a safe place. If you think you were assaulted, go to Isange (3029) as soon as possible.
Nakwirinda nte ko banshyirira ikintu mu cyo kunywa?

Hora ufite icyo kunywa cyawe, wemere ibyo kunywa uhawe n'abantu wizeye cyangwa ibyo ubona bifungurwa, kandi ntusige icyo kunywa ahantu wenyine. Guma hamwe n'inshuti. Niba wumvise utunguranye usinze cyane, ufite urujijo cyangwa ibitotsi, bwira inshuti ako kanya kandi ujye ahantu hatekanye. Niba ukeka ko wahohotewe, jya kuri Isange (3029) vuba bishoboka.
Is smoking cigarettes, vaping or shisha harmful?

Yes. Tobacco and nicotine are addictive and harm the lungs, heart and growth, and smoking increases the risk of cancer. Vapes also contain nicotine and chemicals. Shisha is banned in Rwanda. The earlier you start, the harder it is to stop.
Kunywa itabi, vape cyangwa shisha bigira ingaruka?

Yego. Itabi na nikotine birabata kandi byangiza ibihaha, umutima n'imikurire, kandi itabi ryongera ibyago bya kanseri. Vape nazo zirimo nikotine n'ibindi binyabutabire. Shisha irabujijwe mu Rwanda. Uko utangira kare, ni ko bigorana kureka.
Where can I get help for drug addiction in Rwanda?

Start at your health centre: mental health services there can assess and treat drug and alcohol problems, and refer you if needed. You can also call the free RBC line 114. Rehabilitation centres provide counselling and psychological treatment. Asking for help is a strong step.
Nabona he ubufasha ku kubatwa n'ibiyobyabwenge mu Rwanda?

Tangirira ku kigo nderabuzima: serivisi z'ubuzima bwo mu mutwe zihari zishobora gusuzuma no kuvura ibibazo by'ibiyobyabwenge n'inzoga, kandi zikakohereza ahandi bibaye ngombwa. Ushobora no guhamagara umurongo wa RBC 114 w'ubuntu. Ibigo ngororamuco bitanga ubujyanama n'ubuvuzi bw'ihungabana. Gusaba ubufasha ni intambwe ikomeye.
Which family planning method is best for a teenager?

There is no single best method; it depends on what suits you. Long-acting methods like the implant or IUD work best because you don't need to remember anything and they last years. Pills and injections work well if used on time. Condoms are the only method that also protects against STIs, so many young people use a condom plus another method.
Ni ubuhe buryo bwo kuboneza urubyaro bubereye ingimbi n'abangavu?

Nta buryo bumwe buruta ubundi; biterwa n'icyakubereye. Uburyo bumara igihe kirekire nk'agapira ko mu kuboko cyangwa IUD bukora neza kurusha kuko ntugomba kugira icyo wibuka kandi bumara imyaka. Ibinini n'inshinge bikora neza iyo bikoreshejwe ku gihe. Agakingirizo ni bwo buryo bwonyine burinda n'indwara, bityo urubyiruko rwinshi rukoresha agakingirizo hamwe n'ubundi buryo.
Do antibiotics stop the pill from working?

Most common antibiotics do not stop the pill from working. A few medicines, like rifampicin for TB and some epilepsy and HIV medicines, can make pills, the implant and the emergency pill less effective. Always tell the health worker or pharmacist that you use contraception.
Imiti yica mikorobe ibuza ibinini byo kuboneza urubyaro gukora?

Imiti myinshi isanzwe yica mikorobe ntibuza ibinini gukora. Imiti mike, nka rifampicine y'igituntu n'imiti imwe y'igicuri n'iya virusi itera SIDA, ishobora gutuma ibinini, agapira n'ikinini cyihutirwa bidakora neza. Buri gihe bwira umukozi w'ubuzima cyangwa umufarumasiye ko ukoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro.
Can boys and men use family planning?

Yes. Condoms are the main method for men and protect against STIs too. Vasectomy is a permanent method for men who are sure they want no more children. Men also share responsibility by supporting their partner's choice and going with her to the clinic.

Yego. Agakingirizo ni bwo buryo bw'ingenzi ku bagabo kandi karinda n'indwara. Vasectomie ni uburyo bwa burundu ku bagabo bizeye ko badashaka kongera kubyara. Abagabo kandi bagira uruhare mu gushyigikira icyemezo cy'umukunzi wabo no kumuherekeza kwa muganga.
Is it okay to keep a condom in my wallet?

Heat and rubbing can damage condoms, so a wallet or back pocket is not a good place for a long time. Keep them somewhere cool and dry, check the expiry date, and don't use one if the packet is torn or the condom is dry, sticky or brittle.
Ni byiza kubika agakingirizo mu gikapu cy'amafaranga?

Ubushyuhe no gukubana bishobora kwangiza udukingirizo, bityo igikapu cy'amafaranga cyangwa umufuka w'inyuma si ahantu heza ho kutubika igihe kirekire. Tubike ahantu hakonje kandi humutse, urebe itariki yo kurangira, kandi ntukoreshe agakingirizo niba agapaki kacitse cyangwa agakingirizo kumye, gafatanye cyangwa kavunagurika.
I can't feel my implant in my arm anymore.
If you can't feel your implant, use condoms until a health worker checks it. It may simply be deeper under the skin. The health worker can locate it and confirm it is still working or replace it.
Sinkimva agapira ko mu kuboko kanjye.

Niba utacyumva agapira kawe, koresha agakingirizo kugeza umukozi w'ubuzima agasuzumye. Gashobora kuba kari munsi y'uruhu cyane gusa. Umukozi w'ubuzima ashobora kukabona akemeza ko kagikora cyangwa akagusimburiza.
How soon does the implant or injection start working?

If you get it during the first days of your period, it works right away. Otherwise, use condoms or avoid sex for the next 7 days. The copper IUD works immediately. Ask the health worker which applies to you.
Agapira cyangwa urushinge bitangira gukora ryari?

Niba ubihawe mu minsi ya mbere y'imihango, bihita bikora. Bitabaye ibyo, koresha agakingirizo cyangwa wirinde imibonano mu minsi 7 ikurikira. IUD y'umuringa ihita ikora. Baza umukozi w'ubuzima ikikureba.
How do natural family planning methods work?

Natural methods, like counting days or using cycle beads, mean avoiding sex or using condoms on the days you are most likely to be fertile. They only work well for women with regular cycles of 26 to 32 days and with careful daily tracking. For young people, whose cycles are often irregular, they are much less reliable.
Uburyo bwa kamere bwo kuboneza urubyaro bukora bute?

Uburyo bwa kamere, nko kubara iminsi cyangwa gukoresha urunigi rw'amasaro, bisobanura kwirinda imibonano cyangwa gukoresha agakingirizo mu minsi ushobora gusama. Bukora neza gusa ku bagore bafite ukwezi kudahindagurika kw'iminsi 26 kugeza kuri 32 kandi bakurikirana neza buri munsi. Ku rubyiruko, akenshi rufite ukwezi guhindagurika, ntibwizewe.
What are the signs of gonorrhoea or chlamydia?

They often have no signs, especially in girls. When signs appear, they include burning when peeing, unusual discharge from the vagina or penis, pain in the lower belly, or bleeding after sex. Both are cured with the right antibiotics from a health worker, and partners must be treated too.
Ni ibihe bimenyetso by'imitezi cyangwa chlamydia?

Akenshi nta bimenyetso zigaragaza, cyane cyane ku bakobwa. Iyo bigaragaye, harimo kokera iyo unyara, amatembabuzi adasanzwe ava mu gitsina, uburibwe mu nda yo hasi, cyangwa kuva amaraso nyuma y'imibonano. Zombi zikira iyo zivuwe n'imiti ikwiye itanzwe n'umukozi w'ubuzima, kandi abakunzi nabo bagomba kuvurwa.
What is syphilis and how do I know if I have it?

Syphilis is an STI that often starts as a painless sore on the genitals or mouth, then can cause a rash on the hands and feet. The signs can disappear while the infection stays and harms the body over time. A simple blood test finds it, and it is cured with antibiotics.
Mburugu ni iki kandi namenya nte ko nyirwaye?

Mburugu ni indwara yandurira mu mibonano ikunze gutangira ari igisebe kitababaza ku myanya ndangagitsina cyangwa mu kanwa, hanyuma ikaba yatera uduheri ku biganza no ku birenge. Ibimenyetso bishobora kubura ariko indwara igakomeza kwangiza umubiri uko igihe kigenda. Ikizamini cy'amaraso cyoroshye kirayibona, kandi ivurwa n'imiti yica mikorobe.
I have small bumps like warts on my private parts.

Small, painless bumps can be genital warts, caused by HPV. They are not dangerous but can spread through skin contact during sex. A health worker can confirm and treat them. The HPV vaccine helps prevent them.
Mfite uduheri duto tumeze nk'udusabe ku myanya ndangagitsina.

Uduheri duto tutababaza dushobora kuba udusabe two ku myanya ndangagitsina, duterwa na HPV. Ntitugira akaga ariko dushobora kwandura binyuze mu gukoranaho kw'uruhu mu mibonano. Umukozi w'ubuzima ashobora kubyemeza akanatuvura. Urukingo rwa HPV rufasha kubirinda.
There is a fishy smell from my vagina, especially after sex.

A thin grey or white discharge with a fishy smell is often bacterial vaginosis, a common imbalance that is not usually an STI. It is treated with medicine from a health worker. Avoid washing inside the vagina, as that makes it worse.
Igitsina cyanjye kinuka nk'ifi, cyane cyane nyuma y'imibonano.

Amatembabuzi yoroshye y'ikijuju cyangwa umweru anuka nk'ifi akenshi aterwa n'uguhungabana kw'udukoko dusanzwe mu gitsina, kandi akenshi si indwara yandurira mu mibonano. Ivurwa n'imiti itanzwe n'umukozi w'ubuzima. Irinde koza imbere mu gitsina, kuko bibyongera.
What happens when I go for an STI test?

A health worker will ask a few private questions, may look at the area, and may take a urine sample, a swab or a small blood sample. It is quick and confidential. Many STIs can be treated the same day.
Bigenda bite iyo ngiye kwipimisha indwara zandurira mu mibonano?

Umukozi w'ubuzima azakubaza ibibazo bike mu ibanga, ashobora kureba aho hantu, kandi ashobora gufata inkari, gukora ku gitsina akoresheje agapamba cyangwa gufata amaraso make. Birihuta kandi ni ibanga. Indwara nyinshi zivurwa uwo munsi.
Can I get an STI from oral sex?
Yes. Oral sex can pass infections like herpes, gonorrhoea, syphilis and HPV, though the risk of HIV is low. Using a condom or a barrier reduces the risk.
Nshobora kwandura indwara binyuze mu mibonano ikoresheje umunwa?

Yego. Imibonano ikoresheje umunwa ishobora kwanduza indwara nka herpes, imitezi, mburugu na HPV, nubwo ibyago bya virusi itera SIDA ari bike. Gukoresha agakingirizo cyangwa ikindi kintu kibuza gukoranaho bigabanya ibyago.
Can I get an STI from a toilet seat or sharing towels?

STIs are passed mainly through sex, not toilet seats, swimming pools or sharing cups. A few, like pubic lice, can rarely pass through shared towels or bedding, so it is good hygiene not to share them.
Nshobora kwandura indwara zandurira mu mibonano ku musarane cyangwa nsangiye igitambaro?

Indwara zandurira mu mibonano zandura cyane cyane binyuze mu mibonano, si ku musarane, muri pisine cyangwa usangiye ibikombe. Mbarwa, nk'inda zo ku myanya ndangagitsina, zishobora kwandura gake binyuze mu bitambaro cyangwa amashuka musangiye, bityo ni isuku nziza kutabisangira.
My private parts itch badly at night and I see tiny insects.

This may be pubic lice or scabies, which spread through close contact. They are treated with lotions or medicine from a pharmacy or health centre. Wash your clothes and bedding in hot water, and your partner should be treated too.
Imyanya ndangagitsina yanjye irandya cyane nijoro kandi mbona udukoko duto.

Ibi bishobora kuba inda zo ku myanya ndangagitsina cyangwa ibisebe by'uburyaryate (gale), byandura binyuze mu gukoranaho. Bivurwa n'amavuta cyangwa imiti iboneka muri farumasi cyangwa ku kigo nderabuzima. Mesa imyenda n'amashuka mu mazi ashyushye, kandi umukunzi wawe nawe agomba kuvurwa.
What are the first signs of HIV?

Many people have no signs at first. Some get flu-like symptoms such as fever, sore throat, rash or swollen glands 2 to 4 weeks after infection, which then go away. You can't tell from symptoms; the only way to know is an HIV test.
Ni ibihe bimenyetso bya mbere bya virusi itera SIDA?

Abantu benshi nta bimenyetso bagira mu ntangiriro. Bamwe bagira ibimenyetso bisa n'ibicurane nk'umuriro, kuribwa mu muhogo, uduheri cyangwa kubyimba kw'amatakara mu byumweru 2 kugeza kuri 4 nyuma yo kwandura, hanyuma bigashira. Ntushobora kubimenya ukurikije ibimenyetso; uburyo bwonyine ni ukwipimisha.
Can I get HIV from kissing, hugging or sharing food?
No. HIV does not pass through kissing, hugging, shaking hands, sharing food, cups or toilets, or mosquito bites. It passes through blood, sex without a condom, and from mother to baby.
Nshobora kwandura virusi itera SIDA binyuze mu gusomana, guhoberana cyangwa gusangira ibiryo?

Oya. Virusi itera SIDA ntiyandurira mu gusomana, guhoberana, gusuhuzanya, gusangira ibiryo, ibikombe cyangwa umusarane, cyangwa kurumwa n'umubu. Yandurira mu maraso, mu mibonano idakingiye, no ku mwana akuye kuri nyina.
I am a young person living with HIV and tired of taking pills every day.

Many young people feel this way, and your feelings are valid. Taking treatment every day keeps you healthy and keeps the virus undetectable so you don't pass it on. Talk to your health worker about side effects, reminders, or joining a peer support group of young people living with HIV.
Ndi urubyiruko rufite virusi itera SIDA kandi ndambiwe gufata ibinini buri munsi.

Urubyiruko rwinshi rwumva rutyo, kandi ibyiyumvo byawe birumvikana. Gufata imiti buri munsi bikurinda kurwara kandi bituma virusi itagaragara mu maraso bityo ntuyanduze abandi. Vugana n'umukozi w'ubuzima ku ngaruka z'imiti, uburyo bwo kwibutswa, cyangwa kwinjira mu itsinda ry'urubyiruko rufite virusi itera SIDA.
How long do I take PEP and does it have side effects?

PEP is taken every day for 28 days, without missing doses. Some people feel tired, sick or have stomach upset at first; these usually improve. Don't stop early. Go back for an HIV test after finishing as advised.
PEP ifatwa igihe kingana iki kandi igira ingaruka?

PEP ifatwa buri munsi iminsi 28, nta kwibagirwa. Bamwe bumva bananiwe, iseseme cyangwa ibibazo by'igifu mu ntangiriro; akenshi bigenda bigabanuka. Ntuhagarike mbere y'igihe. Subira kwipimisha virusi itera SIDA nyuma yo kurangiza nk'uko wabigiriwemo inama.
Can I get HIV from razors, tattoos or piercing?
Yes, if the equipment has someone else's blood on it. Never share razors or needles, and only get tattoos or piercings where new, sterile needles are used.
Nshobora kwandura virusi itera SIDA binyuze mu rwembe, tatuwaje cyangwa gutobora amatwi?
Yego, niba ibikoresho biriho amaraso y'undi muntu. Ntugasangire urwembe cyangwa inshinge, kandi ukoreshe tatuwaje cyangwa utobore amatwi gusa ahakoreshwa inshinge nshya kandi zisukuye.
Someone I met online asks me for money or private photos.

Be careful: this is a common scam and can lead to blackmail. Do not send money or photos, stop talking to them and block them. If they threaten you, save the messages and report to RIB on 166. It is not your fault.
Umuntu twamenyaniye kuri interineti ansaba amafaranga cyangwa amafoto yanjye bwite.

Witonde: ubu ni uburiganya bukunze kubaho kandi bushobora gutuma bagukangisha. Ntukohereze amafaranga cyangwa amafoto, reka kumuvugisha kandi umuhagarike (block). Niba agukangisha, bika ubutumwa kandi ubimenyeshe RIB kuri 166. Si amakosa yawe.
How can I keep my social media accounts safe?

Use strong passwords and don't share them, even with a partner. Turn on two-step verification, make your accounts private, and don't post your address, school or location. Think before posting: once shared, photos can spread.
Narinda nte konti zanjye z'imbuga nkoranyambaga?

Koresha amagambo y'ibanga akomeye kandi ntuyasangize, n'umukunzi wawe. Fungura uburyo bwo kwemeza mu ntambwe ebyiri, shyira konti zawe mu ibanga, kandi ntushyireho aho utuye, ishuri cyangwa aho uri. Tekereza mbere yo gushyiraho: iyo ifoto imaze gusakazwa, ishobora gukwirakwira.

Cyberbullying is not your fault. Don't reply, take screenshots, block and report the accounts on the platform. Tell a trusted adult. If there are threats or sexual images, report to RIB on 166, or 116 if you are under 18. Talk to someone if it is affecting your mood.

Gutotezwa kuri interineti si amakosa yawe. Ntubasubize, fata amafoto y'ubutumwa (screenshots), uhagarike kandi urege konti zabo ku rubuga. Bibwire umuntu mukuru wizeye. Niba hari iterabwoba cyangwa amafoto y'urukozasoni, bimenyeshe RIB kuri 166, cyangwa 116 niba uri munsi y'imyaka 18. Vugana n'umuntu niba bigira ingaruka ku byiyumvo byawe.
Someone shared a nude photo of a classmate in our group chat.

Do not share it further and delete it. Sharing sexual images of someone without consent, especially of anyone under 18, is a crime and seriously hurts the person. Tell a trusted adult or report to RIB on 166. Support your classmate rather than joining in.
Umuntu yasakaje ifoto y'umunyeshuri twigana yambaye ubusa mu itsinda ryacu.

Ntuyisakaze kandi uyisibe. Gusakaza amashusho y'urukozasoni y'umuntu atabyemeye, cyane cyane uri munsi y'imyaka 18, ni icyaha kandi bimubabaza cyane. Bibwire umuntu mukuru wizeye cyangwa ubimenyeshe RIB kuri 166. Shyigikira mugenzi wawe aho kwifatanya n'abandi.
My partner and I argue a lot. How can we communicate better?

Choose a calm moment, talk about how you feel using 'I' sentences, listen without interrupting, and look for a solution together. Take a break if things get heated. Arguments happen, but insults, threats or violence are never okay.
Jye n'umukunzi wanjye dutongana kenshi. Twavugana neza dute?

Hitamo igihe gituje, muvuge uko mwiyumva mukoresheje amagambo atangirwa na 'Njye', mutegane amatwi nta guca undi mu ijambo, kandi mushakire hamwe igisubizo. Mufate akaruhuko niba ibintu bishyushye. Gutongana birabaho, ariko ibitutsi, iterabwoba cyangwa ihohoterwa ntibikwiye na rimwe.
I think my partner is cheating on me.

That feeling hurts. Try to talk calmly and honestly with your partner about what you have noticed. Whatever happens, protect your health: use condoms, and consider an STI and HIV test. You deserve a relationship built on trust.
Ndakeka ko umukunzi wanjye amca inyuma.

Ibyo byiyumvo birababaza. Gerageza kuganira n'umukunzi wawe utuje kandi mu kuri ku byo wabonye. Icyaba cyose, rinda ubuzima bwawe: koresha agakingirizo, kandi utekereze kwipimisha indwara zandurira mu mibonano na virusi itera SIDA. Ukwiye urukundo rwubakiye ku kwizerana.
I am 16 and dating a man who is 28.

Big age gaps often mean unequal power, which can lead to pressure, risky sex and less control over your choices. In Rwanda, an adult having sex with someone under 18 is defilement, a serious crime, even if you agree. If you feel pressured or unsafe, call 116 or talk to a trusted adult.
Mfite imyaka 16 kandi nkundana n'umugabo w'imyaka 28.

Itandukaniro rinini ry'imyaka akenshi rizana ubusumbane mu bubasha, bushobora gutera igitutu, imibonano ifite ibyago no kutagira ijambo ku byemezo byawe. Mu Rwanda, umuntu mukuru ukora imibonano n'umuntu uri munsi y'imyaka 18 aba asambanyije umwana, ari icyaha gikomeye, n'iyo waba ubyemeye. Niba wumva uhatirwa cyangwa udatekanye, hamagara 116 cyangwa uvugane n'umuntu mukuru wizeye.
How do I end a relationship safely?

Be clear and calm, choose a public or safe place, and keep it short. If your partner has been violent or controlling, tell a friend or family member first, and consider ending it by message. If you feel unsafe, call the GBV line 3512 or 112.

Vuga neza kandi utuje, hitamo ahantu hahurira abantu cyangwa hatekanye, kandi bibe bigufi. Niba umukunzi wawe yarigeze kuguhohotera cyangwa kukugenzura, banza ubwire inshuti cyangwa uwo mu muryango, kandi utekereze kubimubwira ukoresheje ubutumwa. Niba wumva udatekanye, hamagara umurongo wo kurwanya ihohoterwa 3512 cyangwa 112.
My parents don't allow me to have a boyfriend or girlfriend.

Parents often worry about your safety and studies. Try to understand their concerns and talk honestly. Even if you disagree, it is important to stay safe: avoid secret meetings in isolated places, and know you can still get health information and services if you need them.
Ababyeyi banjye ntibemera ko ngira umukunzi.

Ababyeyi akenshi bahangayikishwa n'umutekano wawe n'amasomo yawe. Gerageza kumva impungenge zabo kandi muganire mu kuri. N'iyo mutabyumvikanaho, ni ingenzi kuguma utekanye: irinde guhurira mu ibanga ahantu hiherereye, kandi umenye ko ushobora kubona amakuru na serivisi z'ubuzima igihe ubikeneye.
Kissing does not pass HIV or cause pregnancy. It can pass colds and cold sores (herpes on the lips). Only kiss when you both want to, and remember you can always say no.

Gusomana ntibyanduza virusi itera SIDA kandi ntibitera inda. Bishobora kwanduza ibicurane n'ibisebe byo ku munwa (herpes yo ku minwa). Musomane gusa mwembi mubishaka, kandi wibuke ko buri gihe ushobora kwanga.
How do I know if it is love or just a crush?

A crush is strong attraction, often to someone you don't know well, and can fade quickly. Love grows over time with trust, respect, care and knowing each other's good and bad sides. Both feelings are normal; take time to get to know the person.
Namenya nte niba ari urukundo cyangwa ari ugukururwa gusa?

Gukururwa ni ibyiyumvo bikomeye ku muntu, akenshi utazi neza, kandi bishobora gushira vuba. Urukundo rukura uko igihe kigenda binyuze mu kwizerana, kubahana, kwitaho no kumenya ibyiza n'ibibi bya buri wese. Ibyiyumvo byombi ni ibisanzwe; fata igihe cyo kumenya uwo muntu.
What does equality look like in a relationship?

Both partners have equal say in decisions, including about sex, contraception, money and time with friends. Both share responsibilities and respect each other's choices, studies and goals. Neither controls or threatens the other.

Abakundana bombi bagira ijambo rimwe mu byemezo, harimo ibijyanye n'imibonano, kuboneza urubyaro, amafaranga n'igihe cyo kumarana n'inshuti. Bombi basangira inshingano kandi bubaha amahitamo, amasomo n'intego by'undi. Nta n'umwe ugenzura cyangwa ukangisha undi.
My boyfriend wants us to have sex without a condom to prove trust.

Using a condom is not about trust; it is about protecting both of you, since many STIs have no symptoms. You have the right to insist on a condom or say no to sex. If you both want to stop using condoms, get tested together first and choose another method for pregnancy.
Umukunzi wanjye arashaka ko dukora imibonano tudakoresheje agakingirizo ngo bigaragaze ko twizerana.

Gukoresha agakingirizo ntibijyanye no kwizerana; bijyanye no kurinda mwembi, kuko indwara nyinshi nta bimenyetso zigaragaza. Ufite uburenganzira bwo gusaba agakingirizo cyangwa kwanga imibonano. Niba mwembi mushaka kureka udukingirizo, banza mwipimishe hamwe kandi muhitemo ubundi buryo bwo kwirinda inda.
My parent or guardian hurts me or touches me in a bad way.

This is abuse and it is not your fault. You deserve to be safe at home. Tell a teacher, relative or another adult you trust, or call the free child helpline 116. If you are in danger now, call 112. Isange One Stop Centres (3029) help children too.
Umubyeyi wanjye cyangwa undera ankubita cyangwa ankoraho nabi.

Ibi ni ihohoterwa kandi si amakosa yawe. Ukwiye kuba utekanye mu rugo. Bibwire mwarimu, uwo mu muryango cyangwa undi muntu mukuru wizeye, cyangwa uhamagare umurongo w'ubuntu wo gufasha abana 116. Niba uri mu kaga ubu, hamagara 112. Isange One Stop Centre (3029) nazo zifasha abana.
Is it abuse if my partner insults me and makes me feel worthless?

Yes. Constant insults, humiliation, threats and making you feel worthless are emotional abuse, which is a form of violence. It is not your fault and you deserve respect. Talk to someone you trust, and you can get confidential help from the GBV line 3512 or Isange 3029.
Ni ihohoterwa niba umukunzi wanjye antuka akantera kumva nta gaciro mfite?

Yego. Gutukwa buri gihe, gusuzugurwa, gukangishwa no kugutera kumva nta gaciro ufite ni ihohoterwa ryo mu marangamutima, kandi ni ubwoko bw'ihohoterwa. Si amakosa yawe kandi ukwiye kubahwa. Vugana n'umuntu wizeye, kandi ushobora kubona ubufasha mu ibanga ku murongo wo kurwanya ihohoterwa 3512 cyangwa Isange 3029.
My family wants me to marry the man who got me pregnant.

No one can force you to marry, and the legal age of marriage in Rwanda is 21. Being pregnant does not mean you must marry. If the man is an adult and you are under 18, it is a crime. You can get confidential help from 116, the GBV line 3512 or Isange 3029.
Umuryango wanjye urashaka ko nshyingiranwa n'umugabo wanteye inda.

Nta wushobora kuguhatira gushyingirwa, kandi imyaka yemewe yo gushyingirwa mu Rwanda ni 21. Kuba utwite ntibisobanura ko ugomba gushyingirwa. Niba uwo mugabo ari mukuru kandi wowe uri munsi y'imyaka 18, ni icyaha. Ushobora kubona ubufasha mu ibanga kuri 116, umurongo wo kurwanya ihohoterwa 3512 cyangwa Isange 3029.
Someone keeps following me and watching me everywhere.

Being followed and watched is stalking, and it can be dangerous. Tell people you trust, avoid walking alone, keep records of when and where it happens, and report it to RIB on 166 or the GBV line 3512. If you are in danger now, call 112.
Hari umuntu uhora ankurikira kandi andeba aho ngiye hose.

Gukurikirwa no kugenzurwa ni ugukurikiranwa ku buryo buteye ubwoba, kandi bishobora guteza akaga. Bibwire abantu wizeye, wirinde kugenda wenyine, wandike igihe n'aho bibera, kandi ubimenyeshe RIB kuri 166 cyangwa umurongo wo kurwanya ihohoterwa 3512. Niba uri mu kaga ubu, hamagara 112.
Is it rape if I was drunk or asleep?

Yes. A person who is asleep, unconscious or too drunk to decide cannot consent, so sex in that situation is rape. It is not your fault, whatever you drank. Go to Isange One Stop Centre (3029) as soon as possible, ideally within 72 hours, for free medical care and support.
Ni ugufatwa ku ngufu niba nari nasinze cyangwa nsinziriye?

Yego. Umuntu usinziriye, wataye ubwenge cyangwa wasinze cyane ku buryo adashobora gufata icyemezo ntashobora kwemera, bityo imibonano muri icyo gihe ni ugufatwa ku ngufu. Si amakosa yawe, icyo wanywa cyose. Jya kuri Isange One Stop Centre (3029) vuba bishoboka, byiza mu masaha 72, ubone ubuvuzi n'ubufasha ku buntu.
I was abused as a child and I still think about it a lot.

Thank you for sharing this. What happened was not your fault, and it is common for memories to come back years later. Counselling can really help. You can talk to a counsellor at a health centre, Isange One Stop Centre (3029), or call the free line 114.
Nahohotewe nkiri umwana kandi ndacyabitekerezaho cyane.

Urakoze kubimbwira. Ibyabaye si amakosa yawe, kandi birasanzwe ko ibyibuka bigaruka nyuma y'imyaka. Ubujyanama bushobora gufasha cyane. Ushobora kuganira n'umujyanama ku kigo nderabuzima, kuri Isange One Stop Centre (3029), cyangwa uhamagare umurongo w'ubuntu 114.
Can I get free legal help after violence?

Yes. Every district has an access to justice office (MAJ) that gives free legal advice. Isange One Stop Centres also connect survivors to police and legal support. You can ask them what your options are before deciding.
Nshobora kubona ubufasha mu by'amategeko ku buntu nyuma y'ihohoterwa?

Yego. Buri karere gafite ibiro by'inzu yo kugeza ubutabera ku bantu (MAJ) bitanga inama mu by'amategeko ku buntu. Isange One Stop Centre nazo zihuza abahohotewe na polisi n'ubufasha mu by'amategeko. Ushobora kubabaza amahitamo yawe mbere yo gufata icyemezo.
I feel the urge to hurt myself. What can I do right now?

Thank you for reaching out. Right now, move to a safe place near other people, put away anything you could hurt yourself with, and contact someone you trust or call the free line 114. Breathe slowly and remind yourself the urge will pass. If you are in danger, call 112.
Numva nshaka kwiyangiza. Nakora iki ubu?

Urakoze kwandika. Ubu, jya ahantu hatekanye hari abandi bantu, shyira kure icyo cyose wakwangiza nacyo, kandi uvugane n'umuntu wizeye cyangwa uhamagare umurongo w'ubuntu 114. Humeka buhoro kandi wibuke ko ubwo bushake buzashira. Niba uri mu kaga, hamagara 112.
My father died and I can't stop feeling sad.

I'm very sorry. Grief can bring sadness, anger, guilt and tiredness, and it comes in waves. Let yourself feel it, talk about the person with people you trust, and keep a daily routine. If the sadness doesn't ease over time or stops you from living, talk to a counsellor or call 114.
Papa wanjye yarapfuye kandi sinshobora kureka kubabara.

Mbabarira cyane. Agahinda ko gupfusha gashobora kuzana umubabaro, uburakari, kwicira urubanza n'umunaniro, kandi kaza kagenda. Emera kubyumva, uvuge kuri uwo muntu n'abantu wizeye, kandi ukomeze gahunda ya buri munsi. Niba agahinda kadahosha uko igihe kigenda cyangwa kakakubuza kubaho, vugana n'umujyanama cyangwa uhamagare 114.
I get angry very quickly and sometimes hit things.

Anger is a normal feeling, but acting on it can hurt you and others. When you feel it rising, step away, breathe slowly and count to ten, or go for a walk. Exercise and talking about what makes you angry help. If anger often gets out of control, talk to a counsellor.
Ndakara vuba cyane kandi rimwe na rimwe nkubita ibintu.

Uburakari ni ibyiyumvo bisanzwe, ariko kubukurikiza bishobora kukubabaza no kubabaza abandi. Iyo wumva buzamuka, va aho uri, uhumeke buhoro ubare kugeza ku icumi, cyangwa ugende gato. Imyitozo no kuvuga icyakurakaje bifasha. Niba uburakari bukunze kukurenga, vugana n'umujyanama.
My family expects too much from me and I feel pressure all the time.

Family expectations can feel heavy. Try to share honestly how you feel with a parent or trusted relative, and focus on doing your best rather than being perfect. Make time for rest and things you enjoy. If the pressure makes you very anxious or sad, talk to a counsellor.
Umuryango wanjye unyitezeho byinshi cyane kandi mpora numva igitutu.

Ibyo umuryango ukwitezeho bishobora kuremera. Gerageza kubwira umubyeyi cyangwa uwo mu muryango wizeye uko wiyumva mu kuri, kandi wibande ku gukora uko ushoboye aho gushaka kuba intagereranywa. Fata igihe cyo kuruhuka no gukora ibyo ukunda. Niba igitutu kigutera guhangayika cyane cyangwa agahinda, vugana n'umujyanama.
Social media makes me feel bad about myself.

Many posts show filtered, edited moments, not real life. If you feel worse after scrolling, try muting or unfollowing accounts that make you compare yourself, set time limits, and spend more time on offline activities and with people who support you.
Imbuga nkoranyambaga zituma numva meze nabi kuri njye.

Ibyinshi bishyirwa ku mbuga ni ibihe byahinduwe kandi byatunganyijwe, si ubuzima nyabwo. Niba wumva umerewe nabi nyuma yo kureba, gerageza guhagarika konti zigutera kwigereranya, kwishyiriraho igihe ntarengwa, no kumara igihe kinini mu bikorwa bitari kuri interineti no hamwe n'abantu bagushyigikira.
I feel that my body does not match who I am inside.

Thank you for sharing something so personal. Questions about gender identity happen to some young people, and your feelings deserve respect. Talking with a counsellor or health worker you trust can help you explore them safely. You deserve safety and good care.
Numva umubiri wanjye udahuye n'uwo ndi we imbere.

Urakoze gusangiza ikintu cyawe bwite gutya. Ibibazo ku bijyanye n'igitsina umuntu yiyumvamo bibaho ku rubyiruko rumwe, kandi ibyiyumvo byawe bikwiye kubahwa. Kuganira n'umujyanama cyangwa umukozi w'ubuzima wizeye byagufasha kubisobanukirwa mu mutekano. Ukwiye umutekano n'ubuvuzi bwiza.
I have stopped eating because I want to be thinner.

Thank you for telling me. Not eating can seriously harm your body and mind, and these feelings are hard to handle alone. Please talk to a health worker soon, or call the free line 114. Telling someone you trust can also help. You deserve support.

Urakoze kubimbwira. Kutarya bishobora kwangiza cyane umubiri n'ubwenge, kandi ibi byiyumvo biragoye kubyihanganira wenyine. Vugana n'umukozi w'ubuzima vuba, cyangwa uhamagare umurongo w'ubuntu 114. Kubwira umuntu wizeye nabyo byagufasha. Ukwiye gufashwa.
My friend seems sad all the time. How can I help?

Ask gently how they are and listen without judging. Let them know you care and spend time together. Encourage them to talk to a counsellor or call 114, and offer to go with them. If they talk about suicide or self-harm, tell a trusted adult right away.
Inshuti yanjye isa n'ifite agahinda igihe cyose. Nayifasha nte?

Mubaze buhoro uko ameze kandi umutege amatwi utamucira urubanza. Mumenyeshe ko umwitayeho kandi mumarane igihe. Mushishikarize kuganira n'umujyanama cyangwa guhamagara 114, kandi wiyemeze kumuherekeza. Niba avuga ku kwiyahura cyangwa kwiyangiza, bibwire umuntu mukuru wizeye ako kanya.
Boys get sick if they don't have sex.
Myth. Not having sex does not harm boys or men. Sperm that isn't released is simply reabsorbed by the body or released during wet dreams.
Si byo. Kudakora imibonano ntibigira ingaruka ku bahungu cyangwa abagabo. Intanga zidasohotse zisubira mu mubiri cyangwa zigasohoka mu nzozi.
You can tell if someone has an STI by looking or smelling.
Myth. Most STIs have no visible signs or smell. The only way to know is to get tested, and both partners should test.
Wamenya ko umuntu afite indwara yandurira mu mibonano umurebye cyangwa umuhumuriza.
Si byo. Indwara nyinshi zandurira mu mibonano nta bimenyetso bigaragara cyangwa impumuro zigira. Uburyo bwonyine bwo kumenya ni ukwipimisha, kandi abakundana bombi bakwiye kwipimisha.
Taking two emergency pills works better.
Myth. Taking extra emergency pills does not give more protection and can cause more side effects. Take the dose as directed, as soon as possible after unprotected sex.
Gufata ibinini bibiri byihutirwa bikora neza kurushaho.
Si byo. Gufata ibinini byihutirwa birenze ntibitanga uburinzi bwinshi kandi bishobora gutera ingaruka nyinshi. Fata urugero rwategetswe, vuba bishoboka nyuma y'imibonano idakingiye.
The implant can paralyse your arm.
Myth. The implant is placed just under the skin and does not affect nerves, muscles or arm movement. Some people have slight bruising or soreness for a few days after insertion.

Si byo. Agapira gashyirwa munsi y'uruhu gusa kandi ntikagira ingaruka ku myakura, imitsi cyangwa uko ukuboko kunyeganyega. Bamwe bagira ibara rito cyangwa uburibwe buke iminsi mike nyuma yo kugashyirwamo.
Cold drinks or cold water during your period cause infertility.
Myth. Cold drinks and water do not affect your period or fertility. Drink what is comfortable for you.
Ibinyobwa bikonje cyangwa amazi akonje mu gihe cy'imihango bitera ubugumba.
Si byo. Ibinyobwa bikonje n'amazi ntibigira ingaruka ku mihango cyangwa ku bushobozi bwo kubyara. Nywa icyo wisanzuyeho.
You can't get pregnant if you have sex standing up.
Myth. Pregnancy can happen in any position. Sperm moves on its own, whatever the position.
Si byo. Gutwita bishobora kubaho uko mwaba muteye kose. Intanga zigenda ubwazo, uko mwaba muteye kose.
Traditional medicine can make someone love you.
Myth. No medicine, potion or charm can make someone love you. Love grows from respect, trust and choice. Some of these products can also be harmful to your health.
Imiti gakondo ishobora gutuma umuntu agukunda.
