Si byo. Nta muti, ikinyobwa cyangwa impigi byatuma umuntu agukunda. Urukundo rukura binyuze mu kubahana, kwizerana n'amahitamo. Bimwe muri ibi bicuruzwa bishobora no kwangiza ubuzima bwawe.
Sex makes boys grow taller and stronger.
Myth. Height and strength come from genes, puberty, good food, sleep and exercise, not from sex.
Imibonano ituma abahungu bakura kandi bakagira imbaraga.
Si byo. Uburebure n'imbaraga biterwa n'uruhererekane, ubugimbi, imirire myiza, gusinzira n'imyitozo, si imibonano.
Does community health insurance (Mutuelle) cover sexual health services?

Community-based health insurance (Mutuelle de santé) covers many services at public health centres and hospitals. Many family planning, HIV and antenatal services are also offered free at public facilities. Ask at your health centre what is covered for you.
Ubwisungane mu kwivuza (Mutuelle) bwishyura serivisi z'ubuzima bw'imyororokere?

Ubwisungane mu kwivuza (Mutuelle de santé) bwishyura serivisi nyinshi mu bigo nderabuzima no mu bitaro bya Leta. Serivisi nyinshi zo kuboneza urubyaro, iza virusi itera SIDA n'izo kwipimisha inda nazo zitangirwa ku buntu mu bigo bya Leta. Baza ku kigo nderabuzima ibyo wishyurirwa.
Can a community health worker give me family planning?

Yes. In Rwanda, community health workers in your village can provide some methods, such as pills, injections and condoms, and advice, and refer you to the health centre for others like the implant or IUD.
Umujyanama w'ubuzima ashobora kumpa uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro?

Yego. Mu Rwanda, abajyanama b'ubuzima bo mu mudugudu bashobora gutanga uburyo bumwe, nk'ibinini, inshinge n'udukingirizo, n'inama, kandi bakakohereza ku kigo nderabuzima ku bundi buryo nk'agapira cyangwa IUD.
Can someone force me to take an HIV test?
No. HIV testing should be voluntary and done with your consent, along with counselling, and your result is confidential. If you are 15 or older, you can consent to testing yourself.
Hari ushobora kumpatira kwipimisha virusi itera SIDA?

Oya. Kwipimisha virusi itera SIDA bigomba kuba ku bushake no ku bwemerere bwawe, biherekejwe n'ubujyanama, kandi igisubizo cyawe ni ibanga. Niba ufite imyaka 15 cyangwa irenga, ushobora kwiyemerera kwipimisha.
What does Intyoza do with what I write?

Intyoza uses your message only to find the best answer. It does not need your name, and it does not share your conversation. If you turn on memory, only the topics you asked about are kept on your phone, not your messages.

Intyoza ikoresha ubutumwa bwawe gusa kugira ngo ibone igisubizo cyiza. Ntikeneye izina ryawe, kandi ntisangiza abandi ikiganiro cyawe. Niba ufunguye uburyo bwo kwibuka, ingingo wabajije zonyine ni zo zibikwa kuri telefone yawe, si ubutumwa bwawe.
Where can I get help at night after violence?

Isange One Stop Centres are linked to hospitals; if the Isange office is closed at night, go to the hospital's emergency department, where staff can give urgent care including medicine to prevent HIV and pregnancy. You can also call 112.
Nabona he ubufasha nijoro nyuma y'ihohoterwa?

Isange One Stop Centre zifatanye n'ibitaro; niba ibiro bya Isange bifunze nijoro, jya muri serivisi z'ibyihutirwa z'ibitaro, aho abakozi bashobora kuguha ubuvuzi bwihuse harimo imiti irinda virusi itera SIDA no gutwita. Ushobora no guhamagara 112.
Where can I learn more about sexual health at school?

Rwanda's school curriculum includes comprehensive sexuality education in science and social studies, covering growth, relationships, rights and HIV prevention. You can also ask your school nurse, patron or matron, or a youth corner at a health centre.
Nakwiga he byinshi ku buzima bw'imyororokere ku ishuri?

Integanyanyigisho z'amashuri mu Rwanda zirimo inyigisho ku buzima bw'imyororokere mu masomo ya siyansi n'imibereho y'abaturage, zigaruka ku mikurire, imibanire, uburenganzira no kwirinda virusi itera SIDA. Ushobora no kubaza umuforomo w'ishuri, umurezi (patron cyangwa matron), cyangwa serivisi z'urubyiruko ku kigo nderabuzima.
I am under 15. Can I still get help at a health centre?

Yes. Health centres help children too. For some services, a health worker may involve a parent or trusted adult, but if you are in danger or being abused, they will help you and protect you. You can also call the free child helpline 116.
Ndi munsi y'imyaka 15. Nshobora kubona ubufasha ku kigo nderabuzima?

Yego. Ibigo nderabuzima bifasha n'abana. Kuri serivisi zimwe, umukozi w'ubuzima ashobora kwitabaza umubyeyi cyangwa umuntu mukuru wizeye, ariko niba uri mu kaga cyangwa uhohoterwa, bazagufasha kandi bakurinde. Ushobora no guhamagara umurongo w'ubuntu wo gufasha abana 116.

A condom is a thin cover, usually made of latex rubber, that a man wears on his erect penis during sex. It stops sperm from entering the vagina, so it prevents pregnancy, and it is the only method that also protects against HIV and other STIs. Use a new condom every time, from the start to the end of sex. There is also a female condom that a woman puts inside her vagina. Condoms are free at health centres and youth corners, and sold in pharmacies and shops.
Health centre; Youth-friendly corner at health centre

Agakingirizo ni agahu koroheje, akenshi gakozwe muri kawucu (latex), umugabo yambara ku gitsina cye cyafashe umurego mu gihe cy'imibonano. Kabuza intanga z'umugabo kwinjira mu gitsina cy'umugore, bityo kakarinda gutwita, kandi ni bwo buryo bwonyine burinda na virusi itera SIDA n'izindi ndwara zandurira mu mibonano. Koresha agakingirizo gashya buri gihe, kuva imibonano itangiye kugeza irangiye. Hari n'agakingirizo k'abagore umugore yinjiza mu gitsina cye. Udukingirizo tuboneka ku buntu ku bigo nderabuzima no muri serivisi z'urubyiruko, kandi tugurishwa muri farumasi no mu maduka.

Family planning means deciding if and when to have children, and using a method to prevent pregnancy until you are ready. Methods include condoms, pills, the injection, the implant and the IUD. Some last a day, others months or years, and all of them are reversible except sterilisation: you can have children after you stop. Condoms are the only method that also protects against HIV and STIs. A health worker or youth corner can help you choose, confidentially.

Kuboneza urubyaro ni uguhitamo niba uzabyara n'igihe uzabyarira, no gukoresha uburyo bwo kwirinda gutwita kugeza igihe witeguye. Uburyo burimo udukingirizo, ibinini, urushinge, agapira ko mu kuboko na IUD. Bumwe bumara umunsi umwe, ubundi amezi cyangwa imyaka, kandi bwose busubirwaho uretse gufunga burundu: ushobora kubyara umaze kubureka. Agakingirizo ni bwo buryo bwonyine burinda na virusi itera SIDA n'indwara zandurira mu mibonano. Umukozi w'ubuzima cyangwa serivisi z'urubyiruko bagufasha guhitamo, mu ibanga.

The emergency pill is a pill a woman can take after unprotected sex, or if a condom broke, to prevent pregnancy. It works best the sooner it is taken: within 3 days for most pills, and up to 5 days for some. It is not an abortion pill: it does not end a pregnancy that has already started, and it does not affect future fertility. It is for emergencies, not for regular use. Ask at a health centre, youth corner or pharmacy.
Ikinini cyo kwirinda gutwita cyihutirwa ni iki?

Ikinini cyo kwirinda gutwita cyihutirwa ni ikinini umugore ashobora gufata nyuma y'imibonano idakingiye, cyangwa iyo agakingirizo kacitse, kugira ngo yirinde gutwita. Gikora neza iyo gifashwe vuba: mu minsi 3 ku binini byinshi, no kugeza ku minsi 5 ku bindi. Si ikinini cyo gukuramo inda: ntigikuraho inda yamaze kujyamo, kandi ntikibuza kubyara nyuma. Ni icy'ibihe byihutirwa, si icyo gukoresha buri gihe. Kibaze ku kigo nderabuzima, muri serivisi z'urubyiruko cyangwa muri farumasi.
What is HIV, and what is AIDS?

HIV is a virus that weakens the body's defence system (immunity) against infections. AIDS is the late stage of HIV infection, when the body has become very weak and gets serious illnesses. HIV passes through unprotected sex, infected blood, and from mother to baby; not through hugging, sharing food or mosquitoes. There is no cure yet, but daily treatment (ART) keeps people healthy and stops HIV from becoming AIDS, and when the virus is undetectable it is not passed on through sex. Testing is free at health centres.
Virusi itera SIDA ni iki, na SIDA ni iki?

Virusi itera SIDA ni virusi icogoza ubudahangarwa bw'umubiri, ari bwo burinda umubiri indwara. SIDA ni icyiciro cya nyuma cy'ubwandu bwa virusi itera SIDA, iyo umubiri wacogoye cyane ukarwara indwara zikomeye. Virusi itera SIDA yandurira mu mibonano idakingiye, mu maraso yanduye, no ku mwana akuye kuri nyina; ntiyandurira mu guhoberana, gusangira ibiryo cyangwa ku mibu. Nta muti uyikiza urabaho, ariko imiti ifatwa buri munsi (ARV) ituma abantu bamera neza ikabuza virusi kugera ku cyiciro cya SIDA, kandi iyo virusi itakigaragara mu maraso, ntiyanduza abandi mu mibonano. Kwipimisha ni ubuntu ku bigo nderabuzima.

Puberty is the time when a child's body changes into an adult's body. It usually starts between 8 and 13 for girls and between 9 and 14 for boys. Hormones cause fast growth, hair under the arms and around the genitals, pimples and new feelings. Girls develop breasts and start their periods; boys' voices deepen, their penis and testicles grow, and they may have wet dreams. Everyone starts at their own time, and all of this is normal.

Ubwangavu (ku bakobwa) n'ubugimbi (ku bahungu) ni igihe umubiri w'umwana uhinduka ukaba uw'umuntu mukuru. Akenshi butangira hagati y'imyaka 8 na 13 ku bakobwa, na hagati ya 9 na 14 ku bahungu. Imisemburo ituma umuntu akura vuba, akamera ubwoya mu maha no ku myanya ndangagitsina, akazana ibiheri n'ibyiyumvo bishya. Abakobwa bamera amabere bagatangira imihango; abahungu ijwi rirahinduka, igitsina n'amabya bigakura, kandi bashobora kurota basohora. Buri wese atangira igihe cye, kandi ibi byose ni ibisanzwe.
What is the menstrual cycle, and what is ovulation?

The menstrual cycle is the monthly process that prepares a woman's body for a possible pregnancy. It is counted from the first day of one period to the first day of the next, usually 21 to 35 days. Around the middle of the cycle, an ovary releases an egg: this is ovulation, and the days around it are when pregnancy is most likely. If the egg is not fertilised by sperm, the lining of the uterus comes out as the period.
Uruhererekane rw'imihango ni iki, kandi ovulation ni iki?

Uruhererekane rw'imihango ni igikorwa kiba buri kwezi gitegura umubiri w'umugore ku buryo ashobora gusama. Rubarwa kuva ku munsi wa mbere w'imihango kugeza ku munsi wa mbere w'ikurikiyeho, akenshi iminsi 21 kugeza kuri 35. Hafi ya hagati y'uruhererekane, agasabo k'intanga karekura intanga ngore: ibyo ni ovulation, kandi iminsi iri hafi yaho ni yo umukobwa ashobora gusama cyane. Iyo intanga ngore idahuye n'intanga ngabo, igice cy'imbere cya nyababyeyi kirasohoka, bikaba imihango.

Reproductive organs are the parts of the body used to make babies. A girl's include the vulva on the outside, and inside the vagina, the uterus (womb) where a baby grows, and two ovaries that hold eggs. A boy's include the penis and the scrotum, which holds two testicles that make sperm from puberty. Knowing the correct names helps you look after your body and explain a problem to a health worker.

Imyanya y'imyororokere ni ibice by'umubiri bikoreshwa mu kubyara. Iby'umukobwa birimo igitsina cyo hanze (vulva), n'imbere: igitsina (vagina), nyababyeyi aho umwana akurira, n'udusabo tw'intanga tubiri tubika intanga ngore. Iby'umuhungu birimo igitsina n'uruhu rw'amabya rubika amabya abiri akora intanga ngabo kuva mu bugimbi. Kumenya amazina nyayo bigufasha kwita ku mubiri wawe no gusobanurira umukozi w'ubuzima ikibazo ufite.

Pregnancy starts when a man's sperm meets a woman's egg. This usually happens during vaginal sex without protection: sperm swim through the uterus to the fallopian tube, where they can fertilise the egg. The fertilised egg then attaches to the wall of the uterus and grows into a baby over about 9 months. A girl can get pregnant the first time she has sex, and even before her first period, because an egg can be released before the first period comes.

Gutwita bitangira iyo intanga ngabo y'umugabo ihuye n'intanga ngore y'umugore. Akenshi bibaho mu mibonano idakingiye: intanga ngabo zinyura muri nyababyeyi zikagera mu muyoboro w'intanga, aho zishobora guhura n'intanga ngore. Intanga ngore yasamye yifata ku rukuta rwa nyababyeyi igakura ikaba umwana mu gihe cy'amezi 9. Umukobwa ashobora gutwita ku mibonano ya mbere, ndetse na mbere y'imihango ye ya mbere, kuko intanga ngore ishobora kurekurwa mbere y'uko imihango ya mbere iza.
What is sexual and reproductive health?

Sexual and reproductive health means being well in body, mind and relationships when it comes to sex, growing up and having children. It includes understanding your body, puberty and periods, making safe choices, preventing unplanned pregnancy, HIV and other STIs, respectful relationships and consent, and being free from violence. In Rwanda, young people have the right to accurate information and to confidential, youth-friendly services at health centres and youth corners.

Ubuzima bw'imyororokere n'imibonano mpuzabitsina ni ukumera neza mu mubiri, mu mutwe no mu mibanire ku bijyanye n'imibonano, gukura no kubyara. Burimo kumenya umubiri wawe, ubwangavu n'imihango, gufata ibyemezo bitekanye, kwirinda inda zitateganyijwe, virusi itera SIDA n'izindi ndwara zandurira mu mibonano, imibanire irimo kubahana no kwemera, no kubaho nta hohoterwa. Mu Rwanda, urubyiruko rufite uburenganzira bwo guhabwa amakuru nyayo na serivisi zigenewe urubyiruko, mu ibanga, ku bigo nderabuzima no muri serivisi z'urubyiruko.

PEP (post-exposure prophylaxis) is HIV medicine taken after a possible exposure to HIV, for example sex without a condom, a condom that broke, or rape. It must be started as soon as possible and within 72 hours (3 days); the sooner, the better. It is taken every day for 28 days. PEP is free at health centres, hospitals and Isange One Stop Centres. If you think you were exposed, go today.
Health centre or hospital today; Isange One Stop Centre 3029

PEP ni imiti irinda virusi itera SIDA ifatwa nyuma yo kugira ibyago byo kwandura, urugero nyuma y'imibonano idakingiye, agakingirizo kacitse, cyangwa gufatwa ku ngufu. Igomba gutangirwa vuba bishoboka kandi mu masaha 72 (iminsi 3); uko itangiwe kare ni ko ikora neza. Ifatwa buri munsi mu minsi 28. PEP itangirwa ubuntu ku bigo nderabuzima, ku bitaro no kuri Isange One Stop Centre. Niba utekereza ko wahuye n'ibyago byo kwandura, genda uyu munsi.

Masturbation means touching your own genitals for pleasure. It is common among both boys and girls, especially during puberty. It does not cause infertility, weakness, madness or any other illness. It is a personal choice: it is done in private, and nobody should pressure you to do it or not to do it.

Kwikinisha ni ukwikorakora ku myanya ndangagitsina yawe ubwawe kugira ngo wumve uburyohe. Bikunze kubaho ku bahungu no ku bakobwa, cyane cyane mu bwangavu n'ubugimbi. Ntibitera ubugumba, intege nke, ubusazi cyangwa indi ndwara. Ni amahitamo yawe: bikorwa mu bwiherero, kandi nta muntu ukwiye kuguhatira kubikora cyangwa kutabikora.

topic_names.STIs and HIV: Indwara zandurira mu mibonano na SIDA

referral_rw.Health centre or hospital today: Ikigo nderabuzima cyangwa ibitaro uyu munsi
referral_rw.Recognised doctor at a licensed hospital: Muganga wemewe mu kigo cy'ubuvuzi cyemewe
referral_rw.GBV line 3512 if unsafe: Umurongo wo kurwanya ihohoterwa 3512 niba udatekanye

10-14.en: Pregnancy can only happen after sex. The surest way to avoid it at your age is not to have sex. When you are older, there are safe methods like condoms, pills and implants, and a nurse can explain them. If anyone pressures or forces you into sex, tell a trusted adult or call 116.
10-14.rw: Inda iterwa gusa n'imibonano. Uburyo bwizewe bwo kuyirinda ku myaka yawe ni ukudakora imibonano. Nukura, hari uburyo butekanye nk'udukingirizo, ibinini n'agapira, kandi umuforomo yabigusobanurira. Niba hari ukuguhatira imibonano, bibwire umuntu mukuru wizeye cyangwa uhamagare 116.

20-24.en: Options include the implant (3 to 5 years), copper IUD (up to 10 to 12 years), injection (every 3 months), daily pill, and condoms, which also prevent STIs. Long-acting methods are the most effective and fertility returns after removal. A nurse can help you choose based on your plans for children, health and preferences.
20-24.rw: Uburyo burimo agapira ko mu kuboko (imyaka 3 kugeza kuri 5), IUD y'umuringa (kugeza ku myaka 10 kugeza kuri 12), urushinge (buri mezi 3), ikinini cya buri munsi, n'udukingirizo, natwo turinda indwara. Uburyo bumara igihe kirekire ni bwo bukora neza kurusha kandi ubushobozi bwo kubyara bugaruka nyuma yo kubukuramo. Umuforomo yagufasha guhitamo ukurikije gahunda yawe yo kubyara, ubuzima n'ibyo ukunda.

10-14.en: Yes. Once a girl has started her periods, sex can cause pregnancy, even the first time. At your age it is best to wait. If someone is pressuring or touching you, that is not okay: tell a trusted adult or call 116.
10-14.rw: Yego. Iyo umukobwa yatangiye imihango, imibonano ishobora gutera inda, n'iya mbere. Ku myaka yawe ni byiza gutegereza. Niba hari ukuguhatira cyangwa ukukorakora, ibyo ntibikwiye: bibwire umuntu mukuru wizeye cyangwa uhamagare 116.

10-14.en: Consent means your body belongs to you. Nobody, not even someone you know or love, should touch you in a way you don't want. You can always say no, and if someone touches you in a bad way or asks you to keep a secret about it, tell a trusted adult or call 116.
10-14.rw: Kwemera bisobanura ko umubiri wawe ari uwawe. Nta muntu, n'iyo yaba uwo uzi cyangwa ukunda, ukwiye kugukoraho mu buryo udashaka. Buri gihe ushobora kuvuga oya, kandi niba hari ukukoraho nabi cyangwa agusaba kubigira ibanga, bibwire umuntu mukuru wizeye cyangwa uhamagare 116.

10-14.en: At your age, your body and feelings are still growing, and it is healthiest to wait. Having a crush or wanting to be close to someone is normal. If anyone, especially an older person, wants sex with you, that is not okay: tell a trusted adult or call 116.
10-14.rw: Ku myaka yawe, umubiri wawe n'ibyiyumvo byawe biracyakura, kandi ni byiza gutegereza. Gukunda umuntu cyangwa kumwiyumvamo ni ibisanzwe. Niba hari umuntu, cyane cyane umuntu mukuru, ushaka ko muryamana, ibyo ntibikwiye: bibwire umuntu mukuru wizeye cyangwa uhamagare 116.

10-14.en: STIs are infections that pass from one person to another mostly during sex. You cannot get them from hugging, sharing food or toilets. Learning about them now helps you stay safe later. If you have questions, ask a trusted adult or a health worker.
10-14.rw: Indwara zandurira mu mibonano ni indwara zandura ziva ku muntu umwe zijya ku wundi cyane cyane mu mibonano. Ntiwazandura uhobera, usangira ibiryo cyangwa umusarane. Kuzimenya ubu bigufasha kwirinda nyuma. Niba ufite ibibazo, baza umuntu mukuru wizeye cyangwa umukozi w'ubuzima.

10-14.en: HIV passes through sex without a condom, through blood, and from a mother to her baby. You cannot get it from playing, hugging, sharing food or mosquito bites. People with HIV can live long, healthy lives with medicine.
10-14.rw: Virusi itera SIDA yandurira mu mibonano idakingiye, mu maraso, no ku mwana akuye kuri nyina. Ntiwayandura ukina, uhobera, usangira ibiryo cyangwa urumwe n'umubu. Abafite virusi itera SIDA babaho igihe kirekire kandi bameze neza iyo bafata imiti.

10-14.en: If you had sex, go to a health centre or tell a trusted adult as soon as possible: there is medicine that can prevent pregnancy if taken within 5 days. If someone forced you or is much older than you, that is not your fault: call 116 or go to Isange (3029).
10-14.rw: Niba wakoze imibonano, jya ku kigo nderabuzima cyangwa ubwire umuntu mukuru wizeye vuba bishoboka: hari umuti urinda gutwita iyo ufashwe mu minsi 5. Niba hari uwaguhatiye cyangwa akuruta cyane mu myaka, si amakosa yawe: hamagara 116 cyangwa ujye kuri Isange (3029).

10-14.en: What happened is not your fault. Tell an adult you trust right away, or call the free child helpline 116. Go to Isange One Stop Centre or a health centre as soon as possible: they will take care of you and keep you safe. If you are in danger now, call 112.
10-14.rw: Ibyabaye si amakosa yawe. Bibwire umuntu mukuru wizeye ako kanya, cyangwa uhamagare umurongo w'ubuntu wo gufasha abana 116. Jya kuri Isange One Stop Centre cyangwa ku kigo nderabuzima vuba bishoboka: bazakwitaho kandi bakurinde. Niba uri mu kaga ubu, hamagara 112.

10-14.en: An adult who gives you money or gifts and wants sex with you is doing something very wrong and against the law. It is not your fault. Do not keep it secret: tell a trusted adult or call the free child helpline 116.
10-14.rw: Umuntu mukuru uguha amafaranga cyangwa impano ashaka ko muryamana aba akora ikintu kibi cyane kandi kinyuranyije n'amategeko. Si amakosa yawe. Ntubigire ibanga: bibwire umuntu mukuru wizeye cyangwa uhamagare umurongo w'ubuntu wo gufasha abana 116.

10-14.en: The law lets people aged 15 and above get these services on their own. If you are younger, you can still go to a health centre: health workers will help you and may involve a trusted adult. If someone is having sex with you, call 116.
10-14.rw: Itegeko ryemerera abafite imyaka 15 kuzamura guhabwa izi serivisi ku giti cyabo. Niba uri muto kuri iyo myaka, ushobora kujya ku kigo nderabuzima: abakozi b'ubuzima bazagufasha kandi bashobora kwitabaza umuntu mukuru wizeye. Niba hari ukorana nawe imibonano, hamagara 116.

10-14.en: Touching your own body is a normal part of growing up and is not harmful. It should be done in private. If anyone else touches your private parts or asks you to touch theirs, tell a trusted adult or call 116.
10-14.rw: Kwikoraho ku mubiri wawe ni ibisanzwe mu gukura kandi nta ngaruka mbi bigira. Bikwiye gukorwa mu bwiherero. Niba hari undi muntu ukora ku myanya ndangagitsina yawe cyangwa agusaba gukora ku ye, bibwire umuntu mukuru wizeye cyangwa uhamagare 116.

10-14.en: Pornography is made for adults and does not show real, respectful relationships. If someone shows you sexual pictures or videos, that is not okay: tell a trusted adult or call 116. If you saw something that upset you, talking about it helps.
10-14.rw: Filime z'urukozasoni zakorewe abantu bakuru kandi ntizerekana imibanire nyayo irimo kubahana. Niba hari ukwereka amafoto cyangwa amashusho y'urukozasoni, ibyo ntibikwiye: bibwire umuntu mukuru wizeye cyangwa uhamagare 116. Niba warabonye ikintu cyakubabaje, kukivugaho bifasha.

10-14.en: Tell a trusted adult and go to a health centre today: there is medicine called PEP that can prevent HIV if started within 72 hours. If someone forced you, it is not your fault: go to Isange (3029) or call 116.
10-14.rw: Bibwire umuntu mukuru wizeye kandi ujye ku kigo nderabuzima uyu munsi: hari umuti witwa PEP urinda virusi itera SIDA iyo utangiwe mu masaha 72. Niba hari uwaguhatiye, si amakosa yawe: jya kuri Isange (3029) cyangwa uhamagare 116.

10-14.en: Love is never proven with sex, and at your age it is best to wait. If someone, especially an older person, pressures you, tell a trusted adult or call 116.
10-14.rw: Urukundo ntirugaragazwa n'imibonano, kandi ku myaka yawe ni byiza gutegereza. Niba hari ukuguhatira, cyane cyane umuntu mukuru, bibwire umuntu mukuru wizeye cyangwa uhamagare 116.

20-24.en: Pregnancy in your twenties is generally safer than in the teenage years, but antenatal care is still essential. Start visits in the first 3 months, take iron and folic acid, and plan to give birth at a health facility. Spacing births at least 2 years apart protects you and your children.
20-24.rw: Gutwita mu myaka 20 kuzamura muri rusange bitekanye kurusha mu bwangavu, ariko kwipimisha inda biracyari ngombwa. Tangira kwipimisha mu mezi 3 ya mbere, ufate fer na acide folique, kandi utegure kubyarira ku kigo cy'ubuzima. Guhana intera y'imyaka nibura 2 hagati y'inda birinda wowe n'abana bawe.

20-24.en: Sex between consenting adults is legal. But an adult who has sex with anyone under 18 commits defilement, punished by 20 to 25 years in prison, or life imprisonment if the child is under 14. The legal age of marriage is 21.
20-24.rw: Imibonano hagati y'abantu bakuru babyemeranyijwe iremewe. Ariko umuntu mukuru ukora imibonano n'umuntu uri munsi y'imyaka 18 aba asambanyije umwana, bihanishwa igifungo cy'imyaka 20 kugeza kuri 25, cyangwa igifungo cya burundu iyo umwana ari munsi y'imyaka 14. Imyaka yemewe yo gushyingirwa ni 21.

10-14.en: Masturbation means touching your own private parts because it feels good. It is a normal part of growing up and is not harmful. It should be done in private. If anyone else touches your private parts or asks you to touch theirs, tell a trusted adult or call 116.
10-14.rw: Kwikinisha ni ukwikorakora ku myanya ndangagitsina yawe kuko byumvikana neza. Ni ibisanzwe mu gukura kandi nta ngaruka mbi bigira. Bikwiye gukorwa mu bwiherero. Niba hari undi muntu ukora ku myanya ndangagitsina yawe cyangwa agusaba gukora ku ye, bibwire umuntu mukuru wizeye cyangwa uhamagare 116.
